notes.title: Confirmed Unstable Network Issue on 21st June
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4328878/a95fdd1ddc473d55c862d443a79603db571a7b9e.jpg[/img]




Dear heroes,


Our team confirmed that the unstable network caused an abnormal game termination around 22:46 PM (PDT) 21st June and we sincerely apologize for this issue.

 

Currently, our team is checking the specific reason and we will share the reason when it reveals clearly.


We'd like to deliver some compensated items as below for heroes who may have experienced this inconvenience.

 

 

 

 

[Compensation Item List]

 



FTG Recovery Potion (1500, 7days) (1)

Magnifying Glass (10)

Magic Wand (5)

 



 

-The item will be delivered on 22nd June at 1:30 AM (PDT) and can be collectible until 29th June 23:59 PM (PDT).

-The item will be delivered on an account basis and above 45 characters can receive them.

-Only characters from created prior to this distribution can receive the above compensation.

-Unclaimed/Expired/Deleted items can't be reimbursed for any reason.

 

 

 

 

Moreover, for inquiries about item loss and non-receivable items caused by this disconnection issue from 22:46 to 22:47 on the 21st of June, please submit a 1:1 inquiry with a screenshot or video attached until 23rd June 23:59 PM (PDT). Our team will review and offer compensation after checking the in-game log.



▶1:1Inquiry Report: https://us.dragonnest.com/support/request

 

 

 

 

 

Once again, we deeply apologize for this issue and kindly ask your understanding.

 
Regards,

EYEDENTITY GAMES

notes.title: July Update Celebration Event
notes.content:
Hello, Heroes.
This is Eyedentity Games.
 
We have a new event to help you strengthen your characters! You will have a chance to get 3 Legendary Rune Dragon’s Wraths and the Varnak Crest. Additionally, if you have this season’s summer costume, you may get a cute gesture! Please see the event details below!!
 
 
[b][Event 1] Daily Combo[/b]
 
Event Period: [b]July 13 after update -> July 27 before maintenance[/b] 
 
Use 10,000 ET / EC every day for a chance to get Legendary Rune Dragon’s Wraths!
Every day, 1 lucky user will win [b]3 Legendary Rune Dragon’s Wraths[/b] and be the luckiest user of the day!
 (If you use 10,000 ET / EC on July 13th, you will be the luckiest user of July 14th.)
Not enough? We’ll make the deal even sweeter! This time, you will receive guaranteed items if you use at least 10,000 ET / EC a day!
You will receive [b]Dragon Egg x 5 + Blue Courier Bird x 5 + Magnifying Glass x 5 + Item Protection Jelly x 5[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7a579e916be1eabdf5180d193909e4cbee8fad42.png[/img]


[b][Event 2] Varnak, the Bright and Sweet[/b]
 
Event Period: [b]July 13 after update -> July 27 before maintenance[/b]
 
Acquire the Bright Sweet Wave Sound Set!
You will receive 1 Varnak Crest if you can collect 1 full set of Sweet Wave Sound (Wings + Tail + Decal)
You can only get the [b]Varnak Crest[/b] once per account.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d23a9005aafa6ac1a44e260eda1127ef53bd2e15.png[/img]

Wave Sound Set Image and Stats

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b354bc2453ff1e9d10907164853948b8adb84475.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e9381e39a9a0dcde76de37d883c47572b944c15d.png[/img]
Varnak Crest


[b][Event 3] Summer Gesture[/b]

[Awakened Passive] Shadow Hand : When a location other than the front part of the enemies is hit, Shadow Hand is enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Burning Coal : Ash deals additional hits when Burning Coal is used.
 
[Awakened Passive] Counter Attack : When enemy’s attack is evaded with Tumble, attack power of certain skills that are used next are enhanced.

Crow Storm (Active) : A skill that can only be used when enough successive skills have been used. It pulls enemies and charges forward to deal powerful damage.
 
Guillotine Cross (Active) : A skill that can only be used when enough successive skills have been used. A bunch of Chain Sickles advances forward on the ground to attack enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Star Combination : Additional Throwing Knives are thrown when Throwing Knife skill is used to gain skill resources.
 
[Awakened Passive] Chain Combination : Additional Chain Sickle is wielded when Chain Sickle skill is used to gain skill resources and it also has a chance of throwing additional Throwing Knives in succession.
 
[Awakened Passive] Edged Fan : Edged Fan returns and you will gain skill resources.
 
[Awakened Passive] Assassinate : When Crow's Deadfall hits enemies accurately, Excess Chain is enhanced.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/43390fec939c1f3ad07f263ae650dc7f921a0320.png[/img][b]Abyss Walker[/b]

[Awakened Passive] Illusion Strike : While the skill is being casted, you can change the location and shoot one more time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Summon Shadow : Shadow is absorbed to enhance oneself.
 
[Awakened Passive] Dark Conviction : Ball of Fire remains on the ground to deal continuous damage on enemies and targets can be set to concentrate the attacks.

[Awakened Passive] Chakra Illusion : Chakra Illusion’s functionality and attack power are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Quantum Trance : Aerial teleport ability that can be used for survival and for following with other skills.

notes.title: Game Patch on 15th June
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
There will be a Game Patch on 15th June, 2017 starting from 02:00HRS (PDT) / 05:00HRS (EDT).
 
During the maintenance, heroes will not able to connect to the game including steam users and is expected to be resumed by 06:00HRS (PDT) / 09:00HRS (EDT).
 
We strongly recommend that you log out of the game before the stipulated time to avoid any item loss.
 
Please be informed that all DNP will be reset in this patch.

notes.title: Black Mara Level up Event
notes.content:
Greetings!
 
Black Mara has finally arrived in Lagendia! Join Black Mara and fully embrace the Dark Magic that Death have given you.
Simply create a Mara character and level her up to level 93 and get 5000 DNP!
 
[b]Event Mechanic:[/b]
Create a Mara Character and level her up to level 93
 
[b]Event Duration:[/b]
18th May 2017 (After update) ~ 15th June 2017 (Before Update)
 
[b]Note:[/b]
- You can participate in the event only once per account.
- Rewards are only given once per account.
- Rewards are given only to account with a Black Mara at max Level 93.
- Rewards will be given on a weekly basis after every weekly maintenance 
- Rewards will be credited on 22th June for players who completed the event during 8th June 2017 - 15th June 2017 (Before the update)
 
[b]Example:[/b]
Dean level up the first Black Mara Character to level 93 and he receives 5000 DNP.
Dean level up a second Black Mara Character in the same account to level 93 and he does not receive another 5000 DNP.
Dean level up a third Black Mara Character in a different account and he receives 5000 DNP.

notes.title: Black Mara Patch Notes 18th May
notes.content:
[u]Changelogs[/u]
- [b]Black Mara[/b]
- [b]Lv 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare 5)[/b]
- Granom Nest Practice Mode
- Bug Fixes
- Dragon Vault Updates

-----

[b]1) New Class: Black Mara[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/85f2bf75b822e98c077b1b9f85261d90f7c0453e.png[/img]

Mara

• Mara has changed Sorceress’s magic to suit her own needs. She can use acute magic attacks quickly or collect energy for a single powerful blow depending on her situation. She can also retreat to escape from danger or summon objects that respond to her attacks.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/108593aa83be72aca4fbde7076a6505aaf306362.jpg[/img]

Black Mara

•Mara can use dark power earned from the contract with darkness to transform into Black Mara. The transformation has attack abilities whereby the character charges at enemies to deal damage while transforming or transforms on the spot while dealing damage on a wider area.
•Main skills are changed and strong damage can be dealt on nearby enemies.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9e6dd35da44354938dabcc54e52a0af1f936858a.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

From May 1st, we will have a donation event until May 7th. For this time, not as usual, we will make your own special title as reward for the winner. Unlike any other title, you can chose your own sentence for the title and we will make a title using your sentence.

notes.title: Redemption of Conversion
notes.content:
From the day of last update, we know many of you already tried to acquire conversion costume and we know most of you are disappointed because of the failure. To be honest, we want to give you more chances to get Conversion Costume and we believe and hope this would be a good chance to redeem previous disappointments.
 
Even if you already purchased eggs and failed, please don’t be discouraged. This event is retroactive and also it guarantees 1 Magical Conversion Thread per every certain amount of Conversion Eggs you purchase.
 
For more details, please see below.
 
 
Event Period:
 
April 13th – April 30th 11:59 PM PDT
 
 
Event Details:
 
- If you already purchased 400+ Conversion Eggs, you will receive 1 Magical Conversion Thread per 400 eggs.
 
- Every 400 Conversion Egg purchase, you will receive 1 Magical Conversion Thread as guaranteed reward.
 
- There is no any limit for the amount of Magical Conversion Thread you can acquire from this event.
 
- Guaranteed Magical Conversion Thread will be distributed every 00:00 AM PDT, 1 day after you reach total 400 eggs purchase.
 
- If you purchase 400 eggs during weekend (including Friday), the reward will be distributed on Monday 00:00 AM PDT.
 
 
Since we want to give you more chance to get Conversion Costume and we want more users can have the costume, the conversion Egg available period has been extended until certain amount of users have the conversion costume full set. Before it gets discontinued, we will announce you first.
Please don’t feel so much pressure on getting Conversion Costume. Until we end the sale, we will do some more encouragement events like this.
 
 
Side Note: Conversion Costume Sale Period Change
 
- Before Change: April 13th – May 18th (Before Update)
 
- Changed Period: April 13th – Until Announcement
 
*Notice: Only eggs are purchased using EC/ET are qualified for this event.
 
 
Again, we hope this event can help you to get conversion costume and reduce your disappointment.
 
Thank you.

notes.title: Deep Sea Dragon Nest Patch Notes 13th April
notes.content:
[h1]Changelogs[/h1]
 
- Deep Sea Dragon Nest
- Dark Banquet Hardcore
- Changes and Addition
A) Lv93 Unique Evolution
B) Lv93 Legend Ice Dragon Equipment Evolution
C) Refined Genesis Accessories
D) Lv93 Dragon Gem Enhancement +14
E) Changes in Guild Master Appointment system
F) Guild Join Request
G) Point Currency System
H) Epic Talisman Evolution
I) Colosseum Rank Reward Improvements
J) Mentor system changes
K) Channel Chat Improvements
L) ATK/HP Notation
M) Evolution Legend Weapon & Legend Main Weapon Converter
N) Courier Bird block function
O) Changes to Dungeon Tab in Social Window
- Others
- Dragon Vault Updates
- Skill Balancing

-----

[b]1) Deep Sea Dragon Nest[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9bf53be85685077b55bb77ce5bd92d449ae91ef4.png[/img]

[u]Entry Info[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1ed1c1d681b18f80eb4f1ba7ca4b59a66c956edd.png[/img]

[u]Quest[/u]

Quest name: Ensemble of the Deep Sea, Nightmare, and Curse

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8d67d0bec313c891228248e123a5167c50eba67b.png[/img]

You can get the quest from Frye the Explorer in Saint Haven.

[u]Rewards[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/39383f86217be6398464cb038aa2685eef6a0666.png[/img]

-----

[b]2) Dark Banquet Hardcore[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/19c1e424e7a8330aa0f2a07b94595a99bc86987f.png[/img]

[u]Entry Info[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bfda463d2953e3e84767bb8410d0a1fa3ebfca29.png[/img]

[u]Quest[/u]

Quest name: Invitation to Dark Banquet

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d77c7facf804dc8e7c7949d79eef4bbd7d6a061d.png[/img]


You can accept the quest via the Remote Quest tab of your Quest Window

[u]Mechanics[/u]
 
Dark Banquet is a special dungeon consisting of 12 floors. The goal is to fight your way up from the 1st floor, and each floor poses different challenges that you have to overcome.
 
The rewards offered gets better with each floor cleared, but so does the difficulty. Should you die in the dungeon, you will not be rewarded. It is up to you to decide if you wish to climb higher for better rewards or leave the dungeon at certain checkpoints with what you have.
 
[u]Rules[/u]
 
- Your HP/MP will be fully recovered when you clear a floor
- Your HP/MP will be fully recovered, and dead teammates will be revived when a boss floor is cleared.
- When all players die, the dungeon will end.
- Heroes and Potions cannot be used in Dark Banquet.
- Stats are equalized in Dark Banquet. 
 
[u]Structure[/u]
 
Dark Banquet consists of Normal Floors and Boss Floors.
In every Normal Floor, you will play one of two possible dungeons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e0d3f779ae53ef767e17b656598eb8022737bbfd.png[/img]

[u]Rewards[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/08d05b168ab91eee5fd9e46f7750b1c27aefa7c4.png[/img]

- Attribute Talismans are a durational talisman of different grades - Low Grade (3 days), Medium Grade (7 days) and High Grade (30 Days).
- In their pouch form, they can be traded. However, once the pouch is opened the contents are no longer tradeable.

-----

[b]3) Changes and Addition[/b]
 
[u]A) Lv 93 Unique Evolution[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/261308f0832df136652a8d19512daf7757965fd2.png[/img]

Level 93 Theano Equipment can now be evolved into Unique grade versions. 
Like all evolutions, Evolution Hammer is required, and all existing Enhancement Levels will be transferred as well.
Evolution Hammer can be crafted at the Blacksmith NPC.
 
 
[u]B) Lv93 Legend Ice Dragon Equipment Evolution[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c188e50775e5e16d03a2e7c1e56f9c51fb46851b.png[/img]

Legend grade Ice Dragon equipment can now be Evolved to stronger versions, and existing enhancement levels will be transferred as well.
Evolution Hammer for Ice Dragon Legend equipment has been added to the Blacksmith NPC.
 
 
[u]C) Refined Genesis Accessories[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8c9591292eff4c063776933a92ee40e57a7b9891.png[/img]

Genesis accessories can now be further enhanced into Refined Genesis accessories via the Blacksmith NPC.
Refined Genesis accessories require level 90 Genesis accessories as materials, as well as Ascension cube, which can be obtained in Deep Sea Dragon Nest.
 
 
[u]D) Lv93 Dragon Gem Enhancement +14[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/35cdd1cb92222f5eaaa9824b5108fbc88783b1b0.jpg[/img]

The max enhancement level for Lv93 Dragon Gems has been increased to 14.
 
 
[u]E) Changes in Guild Master Appointment system[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7c3ba604d5fa3f9d1210ba7eb2ce94c98e5b952a.png[/img]

In order to appoint another player as a Guild Master, you now have to type the words "Appoint Guild Master" in the above window.
 
 
[u]F) Guild Join Request[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/30570eadc5712c56aceb5b47db05f9b48cc55411.jpg[/img]

If a character who is not in a guild wishes to receive Guild Invitations, he may Register Join Request and give a brief self-introduction about himself. 
Once registered, authorized guild members view a list of players who Registered Join Request, and send them an invitation to the guild, or a private message.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/743a637e971340ed3246619797e3a78597f81d99.png[/img]


[u]G) Point Currency System[/u]
 
All currencies in the game has now been unified into the Point Currency System, which can be view in the character window.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c70d15e11665483e7f3e293a439c509be4299ec4.png[/img]

You can select up to 3 different points in the checkboxes, and they will be registered in the inventory window for quicker viewing.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0e9ad4f3d053cf0536e668ced51273c8b5a3c567.png[/img]

You may then use the points at the respective stores for purchasing items. By hovering over the points, a tooltip will appear which will give additional info on the merchant that uses that currency.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6aae2a6c4a7bd2be968d5127b25ef21a884da05e.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/65e827d27c9b87efe5f425d7838a379617e478f2.png[/img]

With this system in place, some currency items will be changed into points. When you obtain the following items, they will be registered as points, and will no longer appear in your inventory.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0121d7bfe8ddf9ea511a29002765ebf8875f9bdc.png[/img]

Existing currencies in your inventory can be exchanged for points at Scholar Stashy.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3b7b7bf18d07c3f70991e7dd095e50ec1599adb8.png[/img]


[u]H) Epic Talisman Evolution[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1b8ff0561b93e8f8eb0ea53e85406cf7503bb6ee.png[/img]

You can now use Talisman Evolution Cube to evolve Rare Talismans to Epic Talismans.
Additional options of the Rare Talisman will be transferred to the Epic Talisman.
Talisman Evolution Cube can be purchase at the Nightmare Star Shop.
 
 
[u]I) Colosseum Rank Reward Improvements[/u]
 
You may now access the Ladder Elite Store from Arena Quartermaster Vincent in Saint Haven.
 
Items sold at the store has also been changed. New items have been added, and purchase restrictions on some items has also changed.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ce2d6fd4bae63df8fe967d2119b840881b564ed2.png[/img]


[u]J) Mentor system changes[/u]
 
- You can now register other players as a Mentor or Pupil as long as there is a difference of 1 level.
- Pupils can now be up to level 92.
- Graduation level for pupils is now changed to level 93. Pupils at level 93 can also choose to graduate immediately or not.
- Pupils will start to accumulate Graduation Points when they reached max level. Once Graduation Points has reached its limit, the pupil will graduate autommatically.
- When max leveled pupils clear nests with their mentors, they get more Mentor Points.
- Level up rewards has been changed. When the pupil reaches level 30, 60, 90 and 93, both Mentor and Pupil will get [Mentor Points] item via mail.
- Mentor points can be earned when both Mentor and Pupil clear dungeons in a party. The points can be spent at Crest Scholar Stashy.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2712d5e3ebcf7bf2d22a5030ae428eeb30f3b3ee.jpg[/img]


- Respect Points has been removed.
- Mentors can register a self-introduction using the Share Intro button in the Mentor UI. Once registered, characters without a Mentor are able to see a list of available Mentors.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9138f079a64463ae1c712b5182a57f2962084b0a.png[/img]


[u]K) Channel Chat Improvements[/u]
 
Channel chat system has undergone a renewal.
Channel chat used to be reset every maintenance. This has changed such that it will be reset near maintenance date when more than 30 days have passed since the last person entered the channel.
 
You can now see a list of chat channels via the Social UI, under the Channel Chat tab.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b0f710130b9f5b997100820d9d2a274622147429.png[/img]

When you create a channel, you may choose to make it public and visible on the channel list, or make it private. The settings can be changed by going to the Channel Settings (Only channel masters has the authority)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bd0600a581f98892b9c2ba98475a69f00e0fb3a9.png[/img]

If you are participating in a channel chat, the Channel Tab in your chat window will remain active.


[u]L) ATK/HP Notation[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5b11b4a342632f0c0819cc9b7ffa752467a664ad.png[/img]

Nest entry info window will now show the recommended ATK and HP required to attempt the nest.
If the recommended stats are higher than the stats you have, it will be shown in Red. If your stats are higher than the recommended stats, it will be shown in Green.
 
 
[u]M) Evolution Legend Weapon & Legend Main Weapon Converter[/u]
 
The Legend Ice Dragon Main Weapon Converter can now be used on Evolution Ice Dragon Weapons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3c1c4764cff0f038b1bd15065db12e12d7ce6687.png[/img]


[u]N) Courier Bird block function[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03141ecaa70376214796934034c20d3025394600.png[/img]

A "Block" option has been added to the popup menu when you click on the character name of a player who used Courier Bird. Once blocked, their Courier Bird messages will no longer appear in your chat window.
 
 
[u]O) Changes to Dungeon Tab in Social Window[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/88d1281e86172b272ab8cccb527e25ef4f6dd9b7.png[/img]

In the Social window, the "Dungeon" tab has been renamed to "Attempts".
The number of Nest and Dungeons that has reached their clear limits will now be reflected in the main headings.

-----

4) Others
 
- When you buy Adventurer's Bag and Extra Storage, they will no longer be automatically applied. Instead, they will now be added into your cash inventory under the Usable tab.
- The expansions can now be used as long as you have at least 1 expandable slot. I.e. If you have a 30-slot bag, but you only have 15 slots left to expand, you will be able to use it to expand the remaining 15 slots (Max inventory slots is still 150)
 
- Unlock condition for NPC Irine has been changed to "Enter [Calderock Pass] or [Saint Haven]".
 
Arena EXP Reset
 
Due to the Arena Reward and Arena System's upgrade, we've decided to reset Arena EXP in June's update.
Reset schedule has yet to be finalized, but we will announce the reset of Arena EXP 1 month before it takes place.
As compensation for the reset, we will reward the following to the top 100 ranks:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8a7d00b5268c5a3abe3dadabf9872bde8e987a23.png[/img]

-----

[b]5) Dragon Vault Updates[/b]
 
[u]Egyptian Costume Set[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f33fa8daeebdf14bb6160b2ef2d013549d3c6b67.png[/img]

*Far Far Away Costume Set will be removed from the Dragon Vault
 
 
[u]Conversion Egg[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b7eb747c75355c631993faa403df16c2c9ec1b4e.png[/img]

Conversion Egg is a special Dragon Egg which has a chance to give a Magical Conversion Thread.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01e1f7f1fdd04533fee0145f24e0785b6ee7b89e.png[/img]

The Magical Conversion Thread can be used to exchange for Conversion Costumes at NPC Cassie.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/247ea3a07580ceae384320bd0c265723c82838a4.png[/img]

Conversion costumes possesses powerful stats, and at the same time allows you adopt the appearance of other cash costumes. 
Once you have a Conversion Costume exchanged from Cassie, head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC (Near Manager Trisha).
 
How to use Conversion Costumes
 
1) Firstly, equip the conversion costume you have exchanged from NPC Cassie

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4d616455958ab3f3c56db236faa8a13d9396f148.png[/img]

2) Head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC, found near Manager Trisha

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2053f74795f37c81b2a77bd428c8057821c65ca7.png[/img]

3) In the Conversion UI, select the costume which you would like to be the appearance of the Conversion Costume.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/724536a1bef9d3b0e30c439abc37df4734f227bb.png[/img]

4) Click Convert
 
5) Congratulations! You have now given your Conversion Costume an appearance!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c592d76fe4bd35e5bbf5a5af6c5aa6919534de.png[/img]

This process does not destroy your appearance costume. You can reverse this process by going to the Magical Costume Mirror, and you can get back the appearance costume. You can even select another costume to use as the appearance at any time.


[u]Dragon Egg[/u]
 
Saber Leo Tiger and Reckless Wukong Spirit has been added to the Dragon Egg

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8e5e14f55a8ae8c7291f39f8efbba10802b4365f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b8e84399caad0a1458b43ac99e72f8b5cea0c3e7.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cc0077bf41a96ccfd0363896c86944345ec231d7.png[/img]

[b]*Rajuul Egg and Rajuul Weapon Egg will be removed from the Dragon Vault in this update.[/b]

-----

6) Skill Balancing
 
*Work-in-progress*

If the recommended stats are higher than the stats you have, it will be shown in Red. If your stats are higher than the recommended stats, it will be shown in Green.

The Legend Ice Dragon Main Weapon Converter can now be used on Evolution Ice Dragon Weapons.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3c1c4764cff0f038b1bd15065db12e12d7ce6687.png[/img]


[u]N) Courier Bird block function[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03141ecaa70376214796934034c20d3025394600.png[/img]

A "Block" option has been added to the popup menu when you click on the character name of a player who used Courier Bird. Once blocked, their Courier Bird messages will no longer appear in your chat window.
 
 
[u]O) Changes to Dungeon Tab in Social Window[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/88d1281e86172b272ab8cccb527e25ef4f6dd9b7.png[/img]

In the Social window, the "Dungeon" tab has been renamed to "Attempts".
The number of Nest and Dungeons that has reached their clear limits will now be reflected in the main headings.

-----

4) Others
 
- When you buy Adventurer's Bag and Extra Storage, they will no longer be automatically applied. Instead, they will now be added into your cash inventory under the Usable tab.
- The expansions can now be used as long as you have at least 1 expandable slot. I.e. If you have a 30-slot bag, but you only have 15 slots left to expand, you will be able to use it to expand the remaining 15 slots (Max inventory slots is still 150)
 
- Unlock condition for NPC Irine has been changed to "Enter [Calderock Pass] or [Saint Haven]".
 
Arena EXP Reset
 
Due to the Arena Reward and Arena System's upgrade, we've decided to reset Arena EXP in June's update.
Reset schedule has yet to be finalized, but we will announce the reset of Arena EXP 1 month before it takes place.
As compensation for the reset, we will reward the following to the top 100 ranks:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8a7d00b5268c5a3abe3dadabf9872bde8e987a23.png[/img]

-----

[b]5) Dragon Vault Updates[/b]
 
[u]Egyptian Costume Set[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f33fa8daeebdf14bb6160b2ef2d013549d3c6b67.png[/img]

*Far Far Away Costume Set will be removed from the Dragon Vault
 
 
[u]Conversion Egg[/u]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b7eb747c75355c631993faa403df16c2c9ec1b4e.png[/img]

Conversion Egg is a special Dragon Egg which has a chance to give a Magical Conversion Thread.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01e1f7f1fdd04533fee0145f24e0785b6ee7b89e.png[/img]

The Magical Conversion Thread can be used to exchange for Conversion Costumes at NPC Cassie.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/247ea3a07580ceae384320bd0c265723c82838a4.png[/img]

Conversion costumes possesses powerful stats, and at the same time allows you adopt the appearance of other cash costumes. 
Once you have a Conversion Costume exchanged from Cassie, head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC (Near Manager Trisha).
 
How to use Conversion Costumes
 
1) Firstly, equip the conversion costume you have exchanged from NPC Cassie

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4d616455958ab3f3c56db236faa8a13d9396f148.png[/img]

2) Head over to the Magical Costume Mirror NPC, found near Manager Trisha

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2053f74795f37c81b2a77bd428c8057821c65ca7.png[/img]

3) In the Conversion UI, select the costume which you would like to be the appearance of the Conversion Costume.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/724536a1bef9d3b0e30c439abc37df4734f227bb.png[/img]

4) Click Convert
 
5) Congratulations! You have now given your Conversion Costume an appearance!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c592d76fe4bd35e5bbf5a5af6c5aa6919534de.png[/img]

This process does not destroy your appearance costume. You can reverse this process by going to the Magical Costume Mirror, and you can get back the appearance costume. You can even select another costume to use as the appearance at any time.


[u]Dragon Egg[/u]
 
Saber Leo Tiger and Reckless Wukong Spirit has been added to the Dragon Egg

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8e5e14f55a8ae8c7291f39f8efbba10802b4365f.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b8e84399caad0a1458b43ac99e72f8b5cea0c3e7.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cc0077bf41a96ccfd0363896c86944345ec231d7.png[/img]

[b]*Rajuul Egg and Rajuul Weapon Egg will be removed from the Dragon Vault in this update.[/b]

-----

6) Skill Balancing
 
*Work-in-progress*

notes.title: Kali Awakening Patch Notes 16th March
notes.content:
Changelogs
 
- Kali Awakening
- Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)
- Changes and Additions
A) Genesis Earrings
B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
C) Gold Pouch Content Added
D) Save Chat Feature
E) Simplified Damage Display
F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
G) PVP Guild Missions Added
H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
I) Heraldry UI Improvements
J) Granom Nest Changes
K) Daredevil Faire Changes
- Dragon Vault Updates
- Skill Balancing

-----------------------------------------------------

1) Kali Awakening
 
 
Awakening Quest: New Power Beckons
 
At level 90, you can accept the awakening quest from Saint Haven's Priestess of Darkness Mocha.
However, you must have already finished the 2nd Specialization to be able to take this quest.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f18fbd729af23389abd2015cfb47424274ba8c51.png[/img]

After completing the related quests, the "Awakening" skill tab will be accessible via the skill window [K], and you may proceed to add the new Awakening Skills.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a1a69887b43710430c8e29c61d6f9a8338a12eb9.png[/img]

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Kali

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c43d24bc0d266fdf14a982ae6a091a09033a381c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/839705bc03ce3f359c876ad4c37e0a744820acf7.jpg[/img]


Awakening - Kali

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/149393e0d115bacdf3ededc6118f1fdb8e9b3979.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09de25095fba0c76381b1f365859a5e13ec35a53.png[/img]Dark Summoner

Deadly Claw : Temporarily enhances Phantom Claw
Shattering Hand : A powerful charging skill using Spirit Hand
[Awakening Passive] Phantom Claw : Number of hits is increased and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit
[Awakening Passive] Resent Area : Cooldown is shortened and critical rate increases for a period of time
[Awakening Passive] Rampage Claw : Rampage Claw’s last attack is enhanced and action speed increases
[Awakening Passive] Chaos Formation : Chaos Formation’s number of hits increases and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/98205cd857f9f5c03d43bf3620c8032dc5c452d5.png[/img]Soul Eater

Summon Totem : Summons a totem in front to curse enemies constantly and enhance oneself
Soul Liberation : Absorbed souls are released to deal powerful damage
[Awakening Passive] Soul Eater : Absorbs souls regularly and recovers own HP
[Awakening Passive] Cling Snake : When Cling Snake hits enemies accurately, cooldown of own skills are recovered
[Awakening Passive] Soul Scream : When Soul Scream hits enemies accurately, the character absorbs additional souls
[Awakening Passive] Specter of Pain : Additional ghosts of pain are summoned for Branded targets

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/911c1c1f6dbea2f09322028c2d61dda2a6cab24a.png[/img]Blade Dancer

Grazing Rush : Throws Chakram in front to paralyze enemies and the character charges in front to deal damage
Blade Step : Uses Chakram to attack and deal powerful damage on nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Graze Dance : Skill speed slows down and the ball pulls nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Sweet Circle : Attack power increases and when the skill hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Breeze Call is recovered
[Awakening Passive] Elegant Storm : Number of hits increases and cooldown is shortened
[Awakening Passive] Squall Flaker : When it hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Graze Dance and Sweet Circle are recovered


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5973a4891c0c696052cbe303512d7e3943d78113.png[/img]Spirit Dancer

Acanthus : Acanthus is summoned to slash enemies and charges in front
Crushing Hammer : Crushing Hammer is summoned to attack by leaping forward after a spin attack
[Awakening Passive] Dusk Hunter : Number of arrows increases and cooldown is saved
[Awakening Passive] Illusion Dance : Cooldown is shortened and earns second turn
[Awakening Passive] Wide Stinger : Attack power increases and recovers cooldown when it hits enemies accurately

----------

2) Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03e128618b42edda4ebf898cf6c80d19487fc0e6.png[/img]

Entry Info

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/213cf72b46c03ad9f42a58c50e5fab95291e5651.png[/img]

The goal is to kill monsters to fill the Nightmare Gauge and attain Nightmare Stars.
 
Events occur at random when the Nightmare Gauge is 50% and 100% filled. Clearing these random events will award you with much more Nightmare Stars.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/342d36c946d8c7d616b0f8135f9861ae74a0b076.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b98a64f8f8bd9d63e9b848088c131daeda8ba369.png[/img]

Rewards
 
Upon defeating the boss at Nightmare Level 4, a reward chest will appear in the centre of the map.
You'll be able to attain items such as Level 93 Magic Talismans and Garnets from the Treasure Chest.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/de79ef581a00fddde792433f227059d15c209eed.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/54768ccd32fe3ae30f8e2a66a4fb94d14be42667.png[/img]

Changes in Nightmare Store

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ed4f22fc09a1e7d868e4759119b65561c49a5c34.png[/img]

----------

3) Changes and Additions
 
 
A) Genesis Earrings
 
Genesis Earrings can now be crafted via the Blacksmith's Crafting Menu.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7e85bc5eead617bd9191c9ac21880fc70a607067.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f86fd2cfc1f6b21ad69ffce9f73f9c111d52f460.png[/img]

To craft Genesis Earrings, you will need Harmony Cubes.
Harmony Cubes can be obtained from Level 93 4-Player Hardcore Nests.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96b567b697a8d92daf761531064c29d5d2c76045.png[/img]


B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
 
Restrictions on item purchase in Ladder Store is no longer based on Ladder Score, but on Rank Tiers no

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/19001ac4cd125ec7c8ac0213b9e5a88f9d8a63ac.png[/img]



C) Gold Pouch Content Added
 
Rarestones can be obtained from Gold Pouches at a very low rate.
The value of these Rarestones is dependent on the Gold Pouch's grade

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4794f2d2b416bd276aa22b051bbd6973a8c479fd.png[/img]


D) Save Chat Feature
 
A feature that allows you to save your chats into a text file has been added.
 
[How to save chats]
 
Click on the chat settings icon at the top-left of the chat window

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/28f5d9cbb1e52a59f05c3f53a960494f8de018fb.png[/img]

You will see a "Save Chat" button.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c86137dc700e0cfb0fe7982f5a42fd5bc333b462.png[/img]

The chat will be saved to the directory /Documents/Dragonnest/Chat 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5957ae42f79b2f7eb6a5139ee0bcdc0ce06bf755.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/26fdce0e7f62060c6276baafb9a4c4b7cd1b1c90.png[/img]


E) Simplified Damage Display
 
Damage values display has been simplified.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5176d54fb4d1a010ce14996c95a4201b9384af27.png[/img]

Comma is added for damage values with more than 4 digits

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/29dc8e6a1907df461e950731c48f1206986f59ae.png[/img]

For values than 6 digits or more, the last 3 digits will be replaced with a "K".
This option can be turned on or off via the game settings, by checking the "Numeric Abbreviation" box.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c0de5815efdbc3bf0c0b35f367e09c21c34b8aa2.png[/img]

Finally, the total damage accumulated from combos will be shown in the screen once the combo is over.
Damages not counted towards combo such as burn and poisoning will not be included in the total damage.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6444dfbc67559d4588ae5c28cf3544cdd4b9093c.png[/img]


F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
 
Quest notification has been added for Specialization and Awakening when they are available so that players won’t miss them out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/46f87b51c59561fddadf1b38f00f0c462152416e.png[/img]

If there is a Specialization/Awakening quest available, a notification will appear at the top of the quickslots upon entering town.
When the "Receive Quest" is selected, the quest will be attained immediately.

To help players better distinguish Specialization/Awakening quests, quest icons on minimaps and above quest NPCs will be changed

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/eb2e168167f549fc05df2a8721c44d6e252eb9bf.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04729ece554f0fff3eb1531f8f0a35e41ea5cd1b.png[/img]


Specialization/Awakening quest in the quest guide will also be of a different color

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d278e5f6553008d8ca1ae60a8227422653d4615e.png[/img]

Specialization/Awakening quests have been separated into another tab in the quest window. You can now view them in the Remote Quest tab in the quest window.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f3e5ad0446c57e0590b55426b03517a40b73dd65.png[/img]


G) PVP Guild Missions Added
 
Guild missions have been added so players can now earn Guild Points when they win in [Colosseum mission room] and [Rank Battle].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/17c2a40357724a9e4b3a1bbab5eb909e1c76d863.png[/img]


H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
 
If there is a difference between next level’s skill cooldown and current level’s skill cooldown, it will be shown in [Next Level Effect] in the skill tooltip. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3f17e0ca694100210a35518a97e9b2cf0aba3e37.png[/img]


I) Heraldry UI Improvements
 
Returning and destroying Heraldries can now be done in the same way as other items.
[Craft Heraldry] and [Return Heraldry] have been removed from Heraldry Scholar NPC.
 
Return Heraldry
Right Click on the equipped heraldry to unequip it (fees apply)
 
Destroy Heraldry
Drag and drop heraldry outside the inventory window to discard it.
 
Change Heraldry
When you try to equip the same type of heraldry as one that is already equipped, it will be replaced with the new heraldry (fees apply).


J) Granom Nest Changes
 
Normal Mode
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- At Stage 4’s line pattern, ghosts that should be protected by the players will appear
 
Hardcore
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- Damage will be lowered when players fail the line pattern in all stages of Hard Core.
 
Stage 4 line pattern improvements
 
- Ghost’s HP gauge has been changed to green.
- Damage received when ghost disintegrates has been lowered.
- The problem of nicknames not being shown has been fixed.


K) Daredevil Faire Store
 
- Level 93 Chaos Fellowship Heraldry has been added.
- Level 90 Chaos Fellowship Heraldry cannot be purchased anymore.

----------

4) Dragon Vault Updates
 
Far Far Away Costume Set

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6aa65fa7354235a5b9edeb53e3a91fd110b755c7.jpg[/img]


Rajuul Hero Weapon Egg

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0ce4d2b71a25b13c6be7605d5b465e3bd1100b14.png[/img]

- Chance to obtain Brilliant Hero's Weapon Exchange Coupon from this special Dragon Egg (Note that this is a different Dragon Egg from the Rajuul Dragon Egg release in the previous patch).
- You can exchange for Brilliant Hero's weapon series from NPC Pania in Saint Haven

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cfc2c098b428a99c4c38433736d61e49ad6e1e9a.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/87539893d052098c05226f2511f25ebc3dd8df67.jpg[/img]


Dragon Egg
 
Silver Dragon's Butterfly Earrings and Silver Dragon's Butterfly Necklace has been added to the Dragon Egg.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09105cca7d5ab17bb9c696f14aa6424baf9aeaf3.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9cee4bc6c3805b211efdd563e400c7f5bf765e26.jpg[/img]


New Ally - Foxy Fox
 
A new growth pet has been added to the cash shop.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6660160607b9a62d3c6c0f630514cde86c1a173b.png[/img]

2 pet accessories has also been added for Foxy Fox
- Dignity Fox Crown
- Progressive Goggle Set

-----------

5) Skill Balancing
 
Awakening Character Skill Balancing
 
Kali
Phantom Guard (PVE, PVP): Phantom Guard is improved.
- MP is no longer deducted when Kali takes damage.
- Reduction in received damage is reduced from 26% to 20%.
Phantom Guard (PVE): Phantom Guard is improved.
- Increase in Super Armour DEF is reduced from 200% to 50%.
- Duration is reduced from 29 seconds to 20 seconds.
Phantom Guard (PVP): Phantom Guard is improved.
- Duration is reduced from 14.5 seconds to 10 seconds.
 
Screamer
Blitz Claw (PVE, PVP): [Phantom’s Rage] is removed from pre-requisites for learning this skill.
Rampage Claw (PVE, PVP): Increase in stun rate is removed.
Rampage Claw (PVE): Additional damage on targets immune to stun is removed.
Rampage Claw (PVE): Attack power increases
- Based on max level ATK: 1306% > 4923%
Hands of Vengeance (PVE, PVP): Reduction in cooldown due to skill level is removed and cooldown will now be based on max level
Phantom Avenger (PVE, PVP): The issue of cooldown recovery effect being applied on [Phantom Avenger] has been fixed.
Invincibility effect has been removed and skill duration is increased.
- Level 3 duration will be increased from 18 seconds to 21 seconds. (PVE)
- Level 3 duration will be increased from 9 seconds to 11 seconds. (PVP)
Phantom Avenger (PVE): Attack power decreases.
- Based on max level ATK : 7723% > 3530%
Humiliation (PVE, PVP): Skill attainment level is increased from Level 15 to Level 19.
Spirit Creeps (PVE, PVP): Curse debuff is removed.
Puppet Dance (PVE, PVP): Skill attainment level is decreased from Level 19 to Level 15.
Puppet Dance (PVE): Cooldown is reduced from 30 seconds to 15 seconds.
Ghost Gate (PVE, PVP): Curse debuff is removed.
Ghost Gate (PVE): Cooldown is reduced from 35 seconds to 28 seconds.
Spirit Wolf (PVE, PVP): Curse debuff is removed.
Begrudge (PVE): Cooldown is reduced from 45 seconds to 25 seconds.
Begrudge (PVE): Attack power increases.
-Based on max level ATK: 118% > 1358%
 
Dark Summoner
Class Mastery (PVE, PVP): The name of bubbles created with Critical attacks will be changed to [Summoning Energy].
- You will no longer attain [Summoning Energy] when Critical occurs for [Phantom’s Rage] and [Blitz Claw].
- Resent Advent is removed and when [Summoning Energy] is full, [Phantom Claw] will be changed to [Phantom Claw Advent].
- Phantom Claw EX Advent’s skill speed will increase.
- When Phantom Claw EX Advent is used, enhancement buff will be removed immediately.
Own Intellect stat will increase when you learn this skill.
- PVE: 50%
- PVP: 15%
Class Mastery II (PVE, PVP): Now Hands of Vengeance EX Instant shares cooldown time with Hands of Vengeance.
- When Hands of Vengeance attack is successful, Hands of Vengeance EX Instant’s cooldown is recovered.
Class Mastery II (PVE, PVP): Increase in own Critical rate is changed to increase in attack power.
 
Soul Eater
Soul Shriek (PVE, PVP): Maximum skill level is increased from Level 9 to Level 13.
Soul Shriek (PVE): Attack power increases.
- Based on max level ATK: 1105 % > 3600%
Class Mastery (PVE, PVP): Own Intellect stat increases when you learn this skill.
-PVE: 50%
-PVE: 15%
Spirit Creeps EX (PVE, PVP): Curse debuff is added.
Specter of Torment EX (PVE): When specter’s curses are stacked, damage given to enemies is reduced from 300% to 150%.
Class Mastery II (PVE): Increase in own attack power is increased from 12% to 30%.
 
Dancer
Windcall Twirl (PVE): Increase in Final Damage is reduced from 60% to 20%.
Illusion Dance (PVE): Increase in Final Damage is reduced from 60% to 20%.
Dance of Ecstasy (PVE, PVP): Maximum skill level is changed from Level 6 to Level 1.
Skill points required to learn this skill has been increased from 3 points to 10 points.
[Ghoul] and [Orc] spirits will not be summoned during the dance and [Dark Elf] and [Minotaur] spirits will be summoned instead.
ㄴ[Dark Elf]
- Additional damage occurs based on enemy’s HP while the spirit is active.
ㄴ [Minotaur]
- Own attack power increases while the spirit is active.
Dance of Ecstasy Part 2 (PVE, PVP): Skill is removed.
Dance of Ecstasy Part 3 (PVE, PVP): Skill is removed.
 
Blade Dancer
Bladeflip EX (PVE): Successful [Twinkle Spin] attack will no longer recover [Hurricane Gust]’s cooldown.
Class Mastery (PVE, PVP): [Second Turn] related effects are changed.
- Skills that create [Second Turn] will be changed to [Chakram Flurry] and [Whirligig].
- When you earn 10 points of [Second Turn], cooldown of [Blade Dance] type of skills will be recovered immediately and action speed will increase for 5 seconds.
Own Strength stat increases when you learn this skill.
- PVE: 50%
- PVP: 15%
 
Spirit Dancer
Class Mastery (PVE, PVP): The skill that creates [Second Turn] is changed to [Dusk Hunter].
Own Strength stat increases when you learn this skill.
- PVE: 50%
- PVP: 15%
 
 
Skill Balancing
 
Gladiator
[Awakening Passive] Triple Slash (PVE, PVP):  Amount of damage per hit increases.
[Awakening Passive] Triple Slash (PVE):  By attaining Awakening Passive skill, the increase in attack power is changed from 50% to 20%.
Now you need to enter additional attack for 4th and 5th attacks.
- 40% ATK for each additional attack
- Before change
ㄴAwakening triple skill based on max level ATK : 3432%
ㄴ 1 hit 20% > 686%
ㄴ 2 hits 20% > 686%
ㄴ 3 hits 20% > 686%
ㄴ 4 hits 30% > 1029%
ㄴ 5 hits 40% > 1372%
- After change
ㄴAwakening triple skill based on max level ATK : 2766%
ㄴ 1 hit 40% > 1106%
ㄴ 2 hits 40% > 1106%
ㄴ 3 hits 50% > 1383%
ㄴ (Additional hit) 1 hit 40% > 1106%
ㄴ (Additional hit) 2 hits 40% > 1106%
[Awakening Passive] Triple Slash (PVP):  By attaining Awakening Passive skill, the increase in attack power is removed.
Now you need to enter additional attack for 4th and 5th attacks.
- 20% ATK for each additional attack
[Awakening Passive] Forward Thrust (PVE, PVP):  Basic skill action has been changed to be the same as Forward Thrust EX.
When the skill is used or while retreating, enter [Back direction key] and it will be changed to attacking on the spot.
 
Archer
Fury of the Owl (PVE): Previous effect is removed and own and party members’ critical damage increases by 10% for 300 seconds.
Fury of the Owl (PVP): Previous effect is removed and own and party members’ critical damage increases by 5% for 300 seconds.
Wisdom of the Owl (PVE): Cooldown is reduced from 120 seconds to 90 seconds.
Wisdom of the Owl (PVP): Cooldown is increased from 60 seconds to 120 seconds.
Wisdom of the Owl (PVE): Previous effect is removed and own critical damage increases by 20% for 15 seconds.
Wisdom of the Owl (PVP): Previous effect is removed and own critical damage increases by 15% for 10 seconds.
 
Paladin
Iron Will (PVP): Super Armour defence power will no longer increase when the skill is used.
Elemental Aura (PVP): Increase in Light attribute attack power is changed from 20% to 10%.
 
Guardian
Stance of Faith EX (PVP): Cooldown is increased from 7 seconds to 15 seconds.
 
Crusader
Mighty Blow (PVP): Attack power is reduced.
- Based on max level ATK: 832%, 1080% > 446%, 590%
Hammer Hand (PVP): Attack power is reduced.
- Based on max level ATK: 587%, 749% > 343%, 425%
 
Priest
Blessing of Strikes (PVP): Increase in Physical and Magic ATK is changed from 27% to 14%.
Blessing of Light (PVP): Increase in Light attribute attack power is changed from 24% to 10%.
Blessing of Light (PVP): Increase in Light attribute defence power is changed from 24% to 5%.
 
Inquisitor
Inquisition (PVE): Developer’s comment-
※ A fatal structural issue has been found on Inquisitor’s 'Inquisition’ skill so it has been changed back to how it was before renewal.
The decrease in attack power with this change has been compensated in other main skills and we are examining whether further improvements can be done on this skill.
When electrocuted targets are hit with Light attribute attack, electrocution effect spreads to enemies within the area at a certain rate and causes additional damage.
Inquisition (PVP): Previous effects are removed and when electrocuted targets are hit with Light attribute attack, electrocution effect spreads to enemies within the area at a certain rate and causes additional damage.
Consecration (PVE): Attack power increases.
- Based on max level ATK: 6287% > 6666%
Judgement Spear (PVE): Attack power increases.
- Based on max level ATK: 1531% > 1702%
 
Engineer
Cannon Quackum (PVE): Attack power increases.
- Based on max level ATK: 597% > 722%
- Same increase for Mechanic Cannon.
Gravity Grenade (PVP): Cooldown is increased from 14 seconds to 24 seconds.
 
Gear Master
Gigaton Quack (PVE): Cooldown is reduced from 26 seconds to 24 seconds.
Class Mastery II (PVE, PVP): Now Gigaton Quack and Gigaton Quack Instant do not share cooldown time.
Mecha-Cannon (PVE): Cooldown is increased from 40 seconds to 45 seconds.
Attack power increases.
- 1 Mecha Duck ATK: 6100% > 7900%
- 2 Mecha Ducks ATK: 9150% > 11850%
- 3 Mecha Ducks ATK: 12200% > 15800%
[Awakening Passive] Mechanic Mode (PVE): Enhancement effects are added to Mechanic skills.
- Mechanic Ice Pump’s attack power increases by 50%.
- Mechanic Cannon’s attack power increases by 20%.
- Mechanic Gatling’s attack power increases by 30%.
- Mechanic Chain Saw’s attack power increases by 15%.
[Awakening] Gravity Grenade (PVP): Damage of 2nd explosion is reduced from 100% to 50%.
 
Physician
Poison Strike (PVP):  Cooldown is increased from 15 seconds to 25 seconds.
Poison Strike (PVP):  Attack power is reduced.
- Based on max level ATK: 1600% > 550%
 
Adept
[Awakening] Ground Zero (PVP): Cooldown is increased from 18 seconds to 32 seconds.
[Awakening] Ground Zero (PVP): Damage due to consecutive explosions is reduced from 70% to 40%.
[Awakening] Ground Zero (PVP): Consecutive explosion’s super armour attack power is greatly reduced.

Thank you for playing Dragon nest and happy hunting!!

notes.title: Kali Awakening Patch Notes 16th March
notes.content:
Changelogs
 
- Kali Awakening
- Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)
- Changes and Additions
A) Genesis Earrings
B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
C) Gold Pouch Content Added
D) Save Chat Feature
E) Simplified Damage Display
F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
G) PVP Guild Missions Added
H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
I) Heraldry UI Improvements
J) Granom Nest Changes
K) Daredevil Faire Changes
- Dragon Vault Updates
- Skill Balancing

-----------------------------------------------------

1) Kali Awakening
 
 
Awakening Quest: New Power Beckons
 
At level 90, you can accept the awakening quest from Saint Haven's Priestess of Darkness Mocha.
However, you must have already finished the 2nd Specialization to be able to take this quest.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f18fbd729af23389abd2015cfb47424274ba8c51.png[/img]

After completing the related quests, the "Awakening" skill tab will be accessible via the skill window [K], and you may proceed to add the new Awakening Skills.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a1a69887b43710430c8e29c61d6f9a8338a12eb9.png[/img]

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Kali

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c43d24bc0d266fdf14a982ae6a091a09033a381c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/839705bc03ce3f359c876ad4c37e0a744820acf7.jpg[/img]


Awakening - Kali

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/149393e0d115bacdf3ededc6118f1fdb8e9b3979.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/09de25095fba0c76381b1f365859a5e13ec35a53.png[/img]Dark Summoner

Deadly Claw : Temporarily enhances Phantom Claw
Shattering Hand : A powerful charging skill using Spirit Hand
[Awakening Passive] Phantom Claw : Number of hits is increased and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit
[Awakening Passive] Resent Area : Cooldown is shortened and critical rate increases for a period of time
[Awakening Passive] Rampage Claw : Rampage Claw’s last attack is enhanced and action speed increases
[Awakening Passive] Chaos Formation : Chaos Formation’s number of hits increases and recovers cooldown of Phantom's Avenger for accurate hit

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/98205cd857f9f5c03d43bf3620c8032dc5c452d5.png[/img]Soul Eater

Summon Totem : Summons a totem in front to curse enemies constantly and enhance oneself
Soul Liberation : Absorbed souls are released to deal powerful damage
[Awakening Passive] Soul Eater : Absorbs souls regularly and recovers own HP
[Awakening Passive] Cling Snake : When Cling Snake hits enemies accurately, cooldown of own skills are recovered
[Awakening Passive] Soul Scream : When Soul Scream hits enemies accurately, the character absorbs additional souls
[Awakening Passive] Specter of Pain : Additional ghosts of pain are summoned for Branded targets

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/911c1c1f6dbea2f09322028c2d61dda2a6cab24a.png[/img]Blade Dancer

Grazing Rush : Throws Chakram in front to paralyze enemies and the character charges in front to deal damage
Blade Step : Uses Chakram to attack and deal powerful damage on nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Graze Dance : Skill speed slows down and the ball pulls nearby enemies
[Awakening Passive] Sweet Circle : Attack power increases and when the skill hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Breeze Call is recovered
[Awakening Passive] Elegant Storm : Number of hits increases and cooldown is shortened
[Awakening Passive] Squall Flaker : When it hits enemies accurately, cooldown of Graze Dance and Sweet Circle are recovered


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5973a4891c0c696052cbe303512d7e3943d78113.png[/img]Spirit Dancer

Acanthus : Acanthus is summoned to slash enemies and charges in front
Crushing Hammer : Crushing Hammer is summoned to attack by leaping forward after a spin attack
[Awakening Passive] Dusk Hunter : Number of arrows increases and cooldown is saved
[Awakening Passive] Illusion Dance : Cooldown is shortened and earns second turn
[Awakening Passive] Wide Stinger : Attack power increases and recovers cooldown when it hits enemies accurately

----------

2) Level 93 Nightmare Dungeon - Deep Abyss (Nightmare III)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03e128618b42edda4ebf898cf6c80d19487fc0e6.png[/img]

Entry Info

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/213cf72b46c03ad9f42a58c50e5fab95291e5651.png[/img]

The goal is to kill monsters to fill the Nightmare Gauge and attain Nightmare Stars.
 
Events occur at random when the Nightmare Gauge is 50% and 100% filled. Clearing these random events will award you with much more Nightmare Stars.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/342d36c946d8c7d616b0f8135f9861ae74a0b076.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b98a64f8f8bd9d63e9b848088c131daeda8ba369.png[/img]

Rewards
 
Upon defeating the boss at Nightmare Level 4, a reward chest will appear in the centre of the map.
You'll be able to attain items such as Level 93 Magic Talismans and Garnets from the Treasure Chest.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/de79ef581a00fddde792433f227059d15c209eed.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/54768ccd32fe3ae30f8e2a66a4fb94d14be42667.png[/img]

Changes in Nightmare Store

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ed4f22fc09a1e7d868e4759119b65561c49a5c34.png[/img]

----------

3) Changes and Additions
 
 
A) Genesis Earrings
 
Genesis Earrings can now be crafted via the Blacksmith's Crafting Menu.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7e85bc5eead617bd9191c9ac21880fc70a607067.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f86fd2cfc1f6b21ad69ffce9f73f9c111d52f460.png[/img]

To craft Genesis Earrings, you will need Harmony Cubes.
Harmony Cubes can be obtained from Level 93 4-Player Hardcore Nests.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96b567b697a8d92daf761531064c29d5d2c76045.png[/img]


B) Ladder Store - Changes in Rank Tier Purchase Conditions
 
Restrictions on item purchase in Ladder Store is no longer based on Ladder Score, but on Rank Tiers no

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/19001ac4cd125ec7c8ac0213b9e5a88f9d8a63ac.png[/img]



C) Gold Pouch Content Added
 
Rarestones can be obtained from Gold Pouches at a very low rate.
The value of these Rarestones is dependent on the Gold Pouch's grade

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4794f2d2b416bd276aa22b051bbd6973a8c479fd.png[/img]


D) Save Chat Feature
 
A feature that allows you to save your chats into a text file has been added.
 
[How to save chats]
 
Click on the chat settings icon at the top-left of the chat window

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/28f5d9cbb1e52a59f05c3f53a960494f8de018fb.png[/img]

You will see a "Save Chat" button.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c86137dc700e0cfb0fe7982f5a42fd5bc333b462.png[/img]

The chat will be saved to the directory /Documents/Dragonnest/Chat 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5957ae42f79b2f7eb6a5139ee0bcdc0ce06bf755.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/26fdce0e7f62060c6276baafb9a4c4b7cd1b1c90.png[/img]


E) Simplified Damage Display
 
Damage values display has been simplified.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5176d54fb4d1a010ce14996c95a4201b9384af27.png[/img]

Comma is added for damage values with more than 4 digits

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/29dc8e6a1907df461e950731c48f1206986f59ae.png[/img]

For values than 6 digits or more, the last 3 digits will be replaced with a "K".
This option can be turned on or off via the game settings, by checking the "Numeric Abbreviation" box.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c0de5815efdbc3bf0c0b35f367e09c21c34b8aa2.png[/img]

Finally, the total damage accumulated from combos will be shown in the screen once the combo is over.
Damages not counted towards combo such as burn and poisoning will not be included in the total damage.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6444dfbc67559d4588ae5c28cf3544cdd4b9093c.png[/img]


F) Enhanced Specialization/Awakening Quest Guide
 
Quest notification has been added for Specialization and Awakening when they are available so that players won’t miss them out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/46f87b51c59561fddadf1b38f00f0c462152416e.png[/img]

If there is a Specialization/Awakening quest available, a notification will appear at the top of the quickslots upon entering town.
When the "Receive Quest" is selected, the quest will be attained immediately.

To help players better distinguish Specialization/Awakening quests, quest icons on minimaps and above quest NPCs will be changed

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/eb2e168167f549fc05df2a8721c44d6e252eb9bf.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04729ece554f0fff3eb1531f8f0a35e41ea5cd1b.png[/img]


Specialization/Awakening quest in the quest guide will also be of a different color

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d278e5f6553008d8ca1ae60a8227422653d4615e.png[/img]

Specialization/Awakening quests have been separated into another tab in the quest window. You can now view them in the Remote Quest tab in the quest window.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f3e5ad0446c57e0590b55426b03517a40b73dd65.png[/img]


G) PVP Guild Missions Added
 
Guild missions have been added so players can now earn Guild Points when they win in [Colosseum mission room] and [Rank Battle].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/17c2a40357724a9e4b3a1bbab5eb909e1c76d863.png[/img]


H) Skill Tooltip Description Added
 
If there is a difference between next level’s skill cooldown and current level’s skill cooldown, it will be shown in [Next Level Effect] in the skill tooltip. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3f17e0ca694100210a35518a97e9b2cf0aba3e37.png[/img]


I) Heraldry UI Improvements
 
Returning and destroying Heraldries can now be done in the same way as other items.
[Craft Heraldry] and [Return Heraldry] have been removed from Heraldry Scholar NPC.
 
Return Heraldry
Right Click on the equipped heraldry to unequip it (fees apply)
 
Destroy Heraldry
Drag and drop heraldry outside the inventory window to discard it.
 
Change Heraldry
When you try to equip the same type of heraldry as one that is already equipped, it will be replaced with the new heraldry (fees apply).


J) Granom Nest Changes
 
Normal Mode
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- At Stage 4’s line pattern, ghosts that should be protected by the players will appear
 
Hardcore
 
- Effects have been added to Stage 2’s Vengeful Tombstone, Delusional Tombstone, Chaotic Tombstone, Infectious Tombstone so that they can be seen more easily even from afar.
- Damage will be lowered when players fail the line pattern in all stages of Hard Core.
 
Stage 4 line pattern improvements
 
- Ghost’s HP gauge has been changed to green.
- Damage received when ghost disintegrates has been lowered.

notes.title: [Event] Conquer Nest with GMs
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
 
Ever wanted to fight alongside our GMs in Nests? Or are you simply just curious if the GMs are half as good as you in running Nests?
 
This Friday, the GMs will be appearing in the game to join you in your Nest runs!
 
 

Event Date
 
16th March 1900 (PST) / 16th March 2200 (EST)
 

Event Mechanics

Two of our GMs will create an Ice Dragon Nest 8-man (Normal) party at the stipulated time.
 
Once the party is fully filled up, the GMs will proceed to run the Nest with the players normally.
 
 
Rewards
 
A server-wide EXP buff will be provided as reward, depending on the progress of the Nest run. The further the nest the party clears, the better the EXP buff.
 
First Boss Clear: +150% EXP
Second Boss Clear: +200% EXP
Third Boss Clear: +250% EXP
Final Boss Clear: +300% EXP
 
The EXP buffs will carry on until Sunday, 19th March 2359HRS (PST).
 

Important notes:
 
- The GMs will join a maximum of 5 parties during the event. However, if there are 3 full clears within the 5 tries, the event will be over.
- To facilitate the event, a nest reset will be carried out during the maintenance on Thursday 16th March.
- The Entry Ticket will be provided 1 hour prior to the start of the event.
- The GM's decision is final.

notes.title: [Event] My Guild, Our Base
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/34545a31d554d4f7a5de076f266c710a490f0aa0.png[/img]

Dear Heroes,
 
 
In the upcoming update, we will be introducing a new system to the game: Guild Base.
 
Guild Base is an exclusive zone that is only accessible by a guild and its guild members. 
 
However, not all guilds will be able to hold a Guild Base. Through future events, only a certain number of guilds will be selected to hold a Guild Base for a limited time.
 
 
Below are some brief information on Guild Base (Detailed information will be released along with the patch notes for the upcoming update)
 
 
Entry Conditions
 
- Character must be at least level 24
- Character must be part of a guild that holds a Guild Base
 
 
Guild Base NPC
 
Guild Base has NPCs similar to those in town. There is also a Guild Base Store NPC, who carry items accessible only to Guild Base holders.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4aaae7fb6397de912b1a7a07bab4a8c6ce961129.png[/img]

Guild Base Store
 
You can buy the following items from the Guild Base Store
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/faa17d65ebe4dc9e9f60486e491a19288d57a2fd.png[/img]

*The Enhancement luck potion increases success rate of enhancement by 10%! (Cannot be stacked with Hot Spring Buff)
 
 
Event
 
We will be holding an event to determine the very first round of Guilds that will hold a guild base!
 
 
Event Period
 
1st March 0000HRS ~ 31st March 2359HRS (PST) / 1st March 0300HRS ~ 1st April 0259HRS (EST)
 
 
Criteria
 
At the end of the event period, the Guild Base will be given to the guilds of the Top 10 donators (via Trisha NPC in Saint Haven).
 
Based on the results by the end of the event, we will award Guild Bases to the winners' guilds on 6th April (during the Maintenance).
These guilds will hold the Guild Base for 5 weeks (until 11th May), where another round of guilds will compete in another event to hold a Guild Base.
 
 
Example
 
Dean is from Guild A, and is ranked 1st in Donation ranking (based on the result on 31st March). Guild A will be awarded a Guild Base on 6th April (assuming Dean stays with Guild A by the maintenance on 6th April)
 
Yaya is from Guild B, and is ranked 2nd in Donation ranking. HOWEVER, Yaya decides to switch guilds to Guild C after the end of the event (1st April to 6th April). In this case, Guild C gets the Guild Base instead.
 
 
Terms and Conditions
 
- Guild bases are given out during the maintenance on 6th April
- Guild bases are given out to the guilds of the top 10 donators (based on results on 31st March). However, this does not mean that the guild they belong to on 31st March will be awarded the Guild Base. See above examples for more information.

notes.title: [Event] Rajuul Egg Promo
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
 
With Rajuul Egg added into the Dragon Vault in the recent patch, we are holding a limited-time promotion for Rajuul Egg purchases!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e4f10f3a15f8559907010f442145daf5753284d2.jpg[/img]

Event Period
 
16th February (after patch) ~ 28th February 2359HRS (PST) / 29th February 0259HRS
 

During the event period, for every 100 Rajuul Eggs* purchased in your account, you will be given a choice of 1 of the following Rajuul Key items:
 
Fascinating Rajuul's Necklace
Fascinating Rajuul's Wing
Fascinating Rajuul's Tail
Fascinating Rajuul's Decal
 

*Up to a maximum of 400 Eggs (4 key items) per account. Purchase with DNP is not eligible for this event
 

Examples
1) Dean buys a total of 200 Rajuul Eggs during the event, he will be rewarded 2 of 4 Key items of his choice

Terms and Conditions
- Rewards are credited on a per-account basis
- Purchase of Rajuul Eggs using DNP is not eligible for the event
- Rewards will be credited on 2nd March during Maintenance
- Promotion only applies to purchases of Rajuul Eggs
