notes.title: Granom Nest Patch Notes 16th February
notes.content:
Changelogs
 
- Granom Nest (Normal / Hardcore)
- Return of Rumble Mode
- Changes & Additions
- Dragon Vault Updates
 
 
1) Granom Nest (Normal / Hardcore)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fa21be4568ccafbaabb7d1f1b28fb33be9dc1a82.jpg[/img]
"And a new experimental subject has walked in... what have you got to offer me?"

Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bc3bf33a1dcb621dc23f0db27b7d6a02a3663924.png[/img]

Rewards
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d92aefb09fd096a508089b4060da8a872fca40fb.png[/img]

Achievements
You may attain the following achievements and titles by clearing Granom Nest:
 
Normal
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/57579003d14ccb6052df0c5ddf4ea1b88ebf70cd.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/80d9d3ced967b8efedbff2ee3ab8224cfaa9b630.png[/img]

Hardcore
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01c14b4ecc6fe86a471caeedb34c69daf4ac3f33.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bd1ab5d6592eb5b237db25eb5048d6021dce3aa9.png[/img]


2) Rumble Mode
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/341f1a05598c51c1ca2eb528f88cb7a5797fe34a.png[/img]

Rumble Mode Changes
- Monster level has been increased to Lv93.
- HP of all monsters (except boss monsters) has been slightly increased.
- A buff that periodically recovers MP will be applied when you enter.
 
Entry Info
1) Press the Matching key (Default: Insert key) or click on the Matching Icon to open the Matching UI
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2cb13c9085e0b41d1b23e52bc3698dd2cd088c2e.png[/img]

2) Click the Battlefield Tab
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/413708dce6faeea3be365e5f09c3b3c604ba2e3e.png[/img]

3) Click the Matching button to begin matching


Rumble Mode Info
- Rumble Mode is a massive PvPvE battlefield, where players have to kill monsters or players from the opposing team within the time limit.
- Up to 12 people (6 per team) can participate in each instance of Rumble Mode.
- Only level 93 characters can participate in Rumble Mode
- Schedule for Rumble Mode is as follow:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a18f7d850e3be3961cf936ec4995cb4e8fd09847.png[/img]
*Above Timings are in PST

Party Matching
- Matching can be done in a party, and the party must have at least 2 members.
- Matching request can be done only by the party leader.
 
Winning Conditions
- The team that collects 30,000 points first is declared the winner.
- If both teams does not reach 30,000 points within the time limit, the team with the higher point will be the winner.
 
Rules
- Points are obtained when monsters or enemy players are killed.
- If you are killed, your points will be deducted. If you are killed by an enemy player, the player who killed you will take the points deducted from you.
- Players with 0 points will not have any points deducted
- You lose 30% of your points if killed by an enemy player, and 50 points (fixed) if killed by a monster.
 
Points
- The following icons will be shown above your character following the amount of points you have
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3094db2705ace5b9896cd0a649f48aaab87be1d0.png[/img]

Monster Hunt
- Various Monsters roam the battlefield, and you will gain points by killing them.
- Some higher grade monsters will appear at certain intervals, which will award more points when killed.
- Certain monsters provide buffs when killed, so be mindful not to let the opponent team kill them.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a41d038ed688c44df1d77ddcc7000415ee5e8fe9.png[/img]

Surrendering
- You may surrender the round, but only after 5 minutes have passed
- To surrender, open the menu by pressing the ESC key, then click on the [Surrender] button
- You will surrender successfully if more than 70% of your team agrees
- If surrender fails, you can request for a surrender again after 1 minute.
 
Re-entry and leaving penalty
- If you are disconnected during the match, you can re-enter when you log in back into the game.
- However, if you choose not to re-enter, a leaving penalty will be imposed on you for 10 minutes.
- With the leaving penalty in effect, you are not allowed to request for Rumble Mode matching.
 
Rewards
- You will be awarded a reward pouch when you win or lose
 
Win
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/78c4cb122a73d5d4e7bad35d6c0014efe0552f4c.png[/img] 

Lose/Draw
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1b3565722eb70d894dd4b7fb61e08f9b6c8b72de.png[/img]

Enhanced Rumble Mode Title Stats
- Rumble Mode Titles' stats has been enhanced
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/69869cc0f1177d541092dae38e62bddd32ebe6bc.png[/img]

Daily/Weekly Tasks
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b47bc9241039725ba83b809c6466e31a3247d147.png[/img]

Store Rewards
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bac3a590fb4d085f6d78ab0ae72202c89bd6292d.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9bc4ca272c842d135782ef7a0344d641aec9b746.png[/img]

3) Changes & Additions
Lv93 Rare Talisman Crafting Added
- Lv93 Rare Talisman can now be crafted
- Brilliant Talisman Fragment and Brilliant Talisman Essence are needed for crafting
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ae9f48434dc6fc2d3914821359efef6da7c8da5e.png[/img]

Lv93 Skill Accessory Crafting
- Lv93 Epic Grade Skill Accessory crafting will be added to Blacksmith NPC’s crafting menu
- Obsession Theano Fragment and Brilliant Technique Fragment (Hero’s Battlefield) are needed for crafting Lv93 skill accessory.
- Obsession Theano Fragment can be obtained by disassembling Lv93 Epic Grade Obsession Theano accessories, which drops from Granom Nest
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8d7d75b5d8a97c81d7bab3e86bb9369be8543af3.png[/img]

Nest Gold Pouch Added
- Epic Grade Gold Pouch will be dropped from Granom Nest

4) Cash Shop Updates
Rajuul Costume Set
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/29fbb0cbd22b8956dd1739bcea949bef1f15176a.png[/img]

New Epic Costumes (From Costume Synthesis Tablet) - Racer Set
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/07c3cbf9ceceaecbff19a4fa56f6d6d28ab788bc.png[/img]

Rajuul Egg
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e4f10f3a15f8559907010f442145daf5753284d2.jpg[/img]
- Chance to obtain Fascinating Rajuul Wing/Tail/Decal and Necklace from this special Dragon Egg (Note that Weapon coupons is not included in the egg this time round)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/141e7d394dddd88a249b2a01583cc326e223fc5f.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f780d80ef8ca989334f69d534c28da409926ac16.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/eda83d5938d530d324934aa800ebfaa3dce3b6ce.png[/img]

Dragon Egg Addition
- Ruby Lustre Dragon mount has been added into the Dragon Egg
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4adee12acdb5693f8030f1f2eee689962ed5c454.png[/img]

notes.title: The DN Artbook Snatch: GM Judgement Day! (Updated)
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
 
For the first time, we have 30 Dragon Nest Official Artbook up for grabs!
 
This is a full-colored, hardcover artbook which features a huge collection of Dragon Nest concept art and images.
 
Stocks are limited, so don't miss the chance to get your hands on this limited-edition loot! Oh, we will be shipping a copy of this right to your doorstep!
 
Below are some sample images of the Artbook:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1e9865ee4c6fa9fb11fbdda46dd61443e886c01a.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6fd3ca4cfa4690b0a5ed6d5986f50a8ce8a162d7.png[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/7244dcbc367049a91d72ec3d552ce33d2be2718c.png[/img]

Event Details
 
Event Period: 9th February 1800HRS (PST) / 2100HRS (EST) Onwards
 
 
During the event, (GM)EYE will create a 1v1 PVP room. This room has no password, and is on a first come first serve basis.
 
All you need to do is to join the room and PVP with the GM. It doesn't matter if you win or lose. Just enjoy a casual round of PVP with the GM, and you're qualified for the Artbook!
 
After every round, the GM will leave the room and create another 1v1 room.
 

If you played against the GM and wish to get the Artbook, you are required to send your personal information to dnevents@eyedentitygames.com, so that we can ship the Artbook to you.
 
For qualified players, below are the information to include in your email to dnevents@eyedentitygames.com:
 
1) Recipient name (Addressee)
2) Phone number
3) Full Address (specifying City, State Province, Country, Zip Code)
4) Game Account (e-mail account and character name)
 
*Your personal information will be kept strictly confidential. It will be used solely for the purpose of shipping the Artbooks, and nothing else.
 
You must send the above information by the end of 16th February in order to receive the Artbook. Shipping of the Artbooks will commence on 23rd February.
 
 
Terms and Conditions
 
- Every account and home address is entitled to only one copy of the Artbook
- Your personal information is compulsory if you wish to receive the reward.
- The GM's decision to qualify/disqualify any player is final.

notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
As said in the title, it is the final week of Jan 2017, so let's pack it up and head up!
 
Enchanted beyond measure, gold is the key to moving forward for all of us.
 
So hop on and enjoy the Golden Fever of the last week!
 
 
Event Period
24th January 0600HRS (PST) / 0900HRS (EST) ~ 30th January 2359HRS (PST) / 31st January 0259HRS (EST)
 
 
At the start of the event, all characters within your account will be rewarded with 10x Golden Egg Coupons (via special storage).
 
Using the coupon will bring you to the cash shop, where you can purchase Golden Eggs, a special Dragon Egg that gives a random amount of gold ranging from 50 ~ 100000 gold.

Do note that Golden Eggs cannot be purchased with DNP.

notes.title: Arch Heretic Patch Note 19th January
notes.content:
1) New Class: Arch Heretic
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ba3af86999eb5591b0353d9d75e118014df4ade9.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c709f772e1becbb5b5f7f9501ad8223facc36ec7.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2fb39f2d37cdbd0f35eaac4a1e184fb149ba22d1.png[/img]

2) Lv93 Twisted Territory (Rhadames)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4e88cef34213768857340ee94662d1406ab8b15c.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/65e9ead814a78fb1f0d0ffc07423211fb7ea70a1.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8f34c669b2336c1f789a2a21dd4aff6b6fcb979a.png[/img]

3) Community System Improvements
Party Reward System Added
For a more active [Community] with active participation of new users, a system with new rewards has been added.
- [Party Reward] tab has been added to [Community (O)] window where you can get additional rewards for playing in a party.
- You can check the information on the rewards you can get for playing in a party.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f78871faecfac2ee26a136d41be0994d91c12643.png[/img]

Party Reward System Details – Accumulated Points
When you play in a party, each character can automatically get [Party Reward Points] listed in [Basic Conditions] and [Recommended Conditions].
- Basic Conditions: Each character in the party will accumulate points based on the party size and cleared location.
- Recommended Conditions : When players equipped with the title “New Hero/Chronicle Hero/Returned Hero” are inside the party, all the party members will get bonus points.
- Accumulated Party Reward Points : You can accumulate up to 10,000 Points and the accumulated points will last until 9am every Saturday.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bf7f9b671d6176d387461cd1b0b9b088bcde505e.png[/img]

Party Reward System Details – Rewarding and Reset
When [Party Reward Points] are fully accumulated, you will automatically receive a reward in your [Mailbox].
- You will see a system message on the chat window when you get the reward.
- When reward is given out, points will not be accumulated anymore and you can accumulate points again when it is reset at 9am on Saturday. (Starts from 0 points)
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b101ccb70dc7a50197a3df40aa10a95138179f7b.png[/img]

4) Growth Guide Added
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4d75c2d1d0ff5521730661edbf4a67d71dee69e7.png[/img]
When your character’s level reaches the maximum, you can see the beginner’s guide about game contents before playing in a [party].
- This is a system that can only be used by characters who reached Lv93 (maximum level).
- After reaching the [max level], why not take a look at [Contents Goals] and [Equipment Collection] to enjoy the game?
* Growth guide speech bubble will not appear anymore when you achieve at least one [Contents Goal].

5) Character Selection/Creation Window Renewal And Chronicle Reopen
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/75214992ed9a4ac3780a49e31128553e60edb357.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/25647f46254a7199c0e01effa1e9b2024c80d86d.jpg[/img]

From 7th January ~ 18th January, claim the following rewards daily when you login:
 
1x Reward Pouch (Goddess's Despair) - 7 days duration upon collection
1x Plate Pouch (Enhancement) - 7 days duration upon collection
 
Do take note that the rewards must be collected daily, as they will remain in your special storage only until the end of the day.

notes.title: Upcoming Contents in Q1 2017
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
2016 had been a breathtaking year.
 
Looking back, shortly after the service transfer, we have opened up the level cap to 93, released various new Nests and most importantly, the 5 awakening classes.
 
We had our many ups and downs. As more content are added, a plethora of bugs and glitches surfaced as well. Our backend systems are less than perfect - our system has sometimes shortchanged rewards for certain events, which has also often caused a huge influx of support tickets.
 
As we kickoff into the New Year, we promise we will work very closely with our partners to improve our service. We would like to thank all Heroes for your continued support for Dragon Nest, and we sincerely appreciate the patience you have given us.
 
 
Without further ado, we present to you the highlights for Q1 2017!
 
 
January - Arch Heretic
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/40f24566f3db1b32cd7dbc85748f914dfe50d584.jpg[/img]
“The kind of power one possesses does not make one good or evil. It is whether the power is used for good, or for evil"
 

The Cleric has always been regarded as a symbol of justice - They wield Holy powers of light to heal and protect their comrades. Especially in PVP, skilled clerics are a force to be reckoned with.

But what about a "Dark Cleric"? This particular Cleric has chosen to embrace the power of darkness - often regarded as unorthodox - against the forces of evil. 

What's his story? Where does he draw his dark powers from?
 
 
February - Granom Nest
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9a4bc525d4a66b80063946acce46933bb33a807d.png[/img]
As the Heroes of Altera explored deeper into the Rhadames territory, they hear stories of a fallen kingdom.

Deep within lives a Child named "Granom", who, unlike others of his kind, possesses rationality and high intellect.

Brave the dangers of Granom Nest to find out Granom's purpose, and scale to new heights with new equipments!

 
March - Kali Awakening
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b35f64e01e97446aeed4f5212f3b9a8bbd226bdd.png[/img]
Will you summon the spirits of darkness and devour the souls of your enemies?
 
Or will you watch your enemies flee in terror from your graceful dance of death?
 
Behold, fellow Kali Heroes. Your time for awakening is finally approaching.
 
 
Do take note that the above are the main contents of the updates in 2017. We will release more information of additional contents such as system changes and balancing once they are confirmed. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 2nd Awakening Events
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 

1) Crystallised Heroes/Heroines
 
As more and more dangers arise to threaten the world of Altera, there is an urgent need of brave heroes to keep the world safe.
 
As time passed, new heroes joined the fight against the ever increasing dangers.
 
Yet, who trained them? What has become of the veterans of days long passed, who fought against the forces of evil and vanished without a trace?
 
This is a call to arms for all old veterans of Dragon Nest! It's time to return and rejoin your friends, guildmates and proteges!

Event Period: 22nd December 2016 (After update) ~ 19th January 2017 (Before update)
 
Eligibility: All accounts that has not logged in for 30 days or more.
 
If you have not logged in for 30 days or more, simply log in to the game during the event period, climb to the specified levels, and you will be given a set of Crystal Wing/Tail/Decal.
 
We will reward the items based on the highest level character in the account (as of the end of the event). 
 
Level 70 ~ 80: Crystal Ancestor Dragon Decal
Level 81 ~ 90: Crystal Ancestor Dragon Tail
Level 91 ~ 93: Crystal Ancestor Dragon Wings

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cc4b0735d01a946740685adef10c1abde178f33b.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/caf87d454a7b01cc78188fe15de6eb6ec42cc5cd.png[/img]

Important Notes:
- Rewards will be credited to the highest level character in the account.
- Rewards will be credited on 19th January 2017 (during patch downtime)


2) Awaken, fellow Clerics and Academics!
 
Event Period: 22nd December 2016 (After update) ~ 19th January 2017 (Before update)

Eligibility: Newly Created Clerics and Academics after 2nd Awakening Update.
 
For Clerics and Academics created after the 2nd Awakening Update, simply reach level 93, complete the awakening quest, and you will receive a Oasis Costume Set.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6fdaa3b32ed4d9fbd7db40674c0f080ae3dd8c29.png[/img]

Important Notes:
- Rewards are credited per-character basis. If you have multiple new clerics/academics in your account that fulfills the criteria, they will all receive costumes!
- Rewards will be credited on 19th January 2017 (during patch downtime)

If you have not logged in for 30 days or more, simply log in to the game during the event period, climb to the specified levels, and you will be given a set of Crystal Wing/Tail/Decal.
 
We will reward the items based on the highest level character in the account (as of the end of the event). 
 
Level 70 ~ 80: Crystal Ancestor Dragon Decal
Level 81 ~ 90: Crystal Ancestor Dragon Tail
Level 91 ~ 93: Crystal Ancestor Dragon Wings

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cc4b0735d01a946740685adef10c1abde178f33b.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/caf87d454a7b01cc78188fe15de6eb6ec42cc5cd.png[/img]

Important Notes:
- Rewards will be credited to the highest level character in the account.
- Rewards will be credited on 19th January 2017 (during patch downtime)


2) Awaken, fellow Clerics and Academics!
 
Event Period: 22nd December 2016 (After update) ~ 19th January 2017 (Before update)

Eligibility: Newly Created Clerics and Academics after 2nd Awakening Update.
 
For Clerics and Academics created after the 2nd Awakening Update, simply reach level 93, complete the awakening quest, and you will receive a Oasis Costume Set.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6fdaa3b32ed4d9fbd7db40674c0f080ae3dd8c29.png[/img]

Important Notes:
- Rewards are credited per-character basis. If you have multiple new clerics/academics in your account that fulfills the criteria, they will all receive costumes!
- Rewards will be credited on 19th January 2017 (during patch downtime)

notes.title: 2nd Awakening Patch Notes 22nd December [Work-In-Progress]
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/823dd3596b064ab9b296c86d57c1c60a21691073.png[/img]

1) 2nd Awakening: Cleric & Academic
  
Awakening Quest: New Power Beckons
 
At level 90, you can accept the awakening quest from Saint Haven's Priestess of Darkness Mocha.
However, you must have already finished the 2nd Specialization to be able to take this quest.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ac211aa649967411d7a4d92db1c7c043b5dbf45d.png[/img]

After completing the related quests, the "Awakening" skill tab will be accessible via the skill window [K], and you may proceed to add the new Awakening Skills.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ce0eecbb308a3c06508d4fc43fdc91030f937ef4.png[/img]

Completing the Awakening quest will also reward you with an Awakening Costume Coupon (7 Days). You'll be able to purchase Awakened Costumes for Cleric and Academic.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e71bad8d2955cb8546787ac5bd986a28cc84615c.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/9dfc8728c1026fb84a0fd13a748c78bc21e53efe.png[/img]
*Please note that Awakening Costumes for Warrior, Archer and Sorceress will be removed in this patch. 

Awakening - Cleric
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5df855b58015828f6d83354ae7db27233593a1f1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/6e5294740eedb465a47340682a4037c29a74fec5.png[/img] Guardian
Thrust Force (Active) : Flings Divine Chain forward. Should it hit an enemy, the Cleric pulls himself towards them thus damaging them as well.
 
Overwhelm (Active) : Amplifies Holy Energy and slams the ground. Press Normal Attack right after casting the skill to spend 3 Guardian Bubbles to deal additional damage.
 
[Awakened Passive] Guardian Force : Damages enemies by shattering a Holy Shield. The shards produced as a result of the skill additionally deals damage at random locations.
 
[Awakened Passive] Armour Break : The skill changes to Light Attribute, Attack Power increases and gain an additional attack. Attain 1 Guardian Bubble when the skill hits enemies accurately.
 
[Awakened Passive] Shield Charge : Charges at a shorter distance but Attack Power is increased and the skill has changed to Light Attribute. Attack area of the final uppercut attack is greatly increased.
 
[Awakened Passive] Stance of Faith : Block enemies’ attack at the right timing to recover a certain amount of HP.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/587d28463cfa36131c352db7f6f3ac4341eeb66a.png[/img] Crusader
Mighty Blow (Active) : Jumps high up into the air and glides for a while. Attacks nearby enemies with lightning when descending. Has a chance to Electrocute enemies.
 
Hammer Hand (Active) : The Hammer Hand is summoned from the heavens to rain justice down on enemies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Divine Combo : The skill is changed to Light Attribute and Attack Power increases. During a combo, press the Normal Attack to shoot Holy Lightning.
 
[Awakened Passive] Holy Relic : A Holy Orb is created where the Holy Relic lands. Holy Orb Increases user's Light Attribute Attack Power.
 
[Awakened Passive] Lightning Zap : When skills related to Electrocute successfully hits enemies, Lightning Zap's cooldown is recovered by 3 seconds. The Charger state debuff will be changed to God's Stigma debuff. When the attacked target is in God's Stigma debuff state, God's Judgement lightning will strike the target after 0.5 seconds.
 
[Awakened Passive] Judge's Power : Final Damage effect is applied when the skill is used.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ab64142ecdaa4b8f8596ce273e4ddb5a9c703f08.png[/img] Saint
Antiphona Pool (Active) : Summon a Holy Orb that damages enemies and explodes at regular intervals to deal more damage.
 
Blessed Sign (Active) : Holy Energy within the body is amplified and released. The closer enemies are to the Cleric’s Holy Energy, the more damage they will receive.
 
[Awakened Passive] Lightning Relic : The relic automatically summons Small Lightning Relics nearby. Small Lightning Relics deal high damage to the area where they land and emits constant Electric Damage to enemies nearby.
 
[Awakened Passive] Grand Cross : Holy Explosion when the Grand Cross disappears deals more damage.
 
[Awakened Passive] Holy Burst : Skill is now emitted around the summoned Relic instead of the Cleric.owerful light is summoned not around the player but around the summoned relic to amplify damage.
 
[Awakened Passive] Great Heal : When Great Heal is activated, Power of Light recovers HP proportional to the user’s Magic Attack at regular intervals.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/60b27d5845d48f6f1eefda786695ed2a454e4bc3.png[/img] Inquisitor
Judgement Spear (Active) : After a short run-up, the Judgement Spear is thrown forward whereby it flies at a high speed. Targets and nearby enemies are damaged and electrocuted as a result.
 
Lightning Storm (Active) : Shoots lightning high up into the sky to summon powerful lightning clouds. Constantly creates lightning when the lightning cloud is completed which Electrocutes enemies and deals high damage. Number of lightning produced is greatly reduced, while lightning cloud remains present even when skills are used on the Cleric to cancel the action.
 
[Awakened Passive] Lightning Bolt: Attack Power is increased and when it hits enemies, the cooldown on Judgement Spear is refreshed once.
 
[Awakened Passive] Detonate: Lightning emanating from the Cleric is removed and has a 50% chance of enhancing Detonate.
 
[Awakened Passive] Avenging Wave: Attack Power is increased, while Cooldown is reduced. This skill can be activated immediately during Judgement Spear, Lightning Storm.
 
[Awakened Passive] Consecration: Light Attribute Attack Power increases when standing on Holy Power.


Awakening - Academic
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/348a1f934df16156c1c709fc26edbe8bb0514a4e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/252de66db54b01d84404ee0d99246ba18ce0feb1.png[/img] Gear Master
Tower Recall: All summoned towers are summoned to the Academic’s location.
 
Mecha Cannon: All summoned Mecha Ducks are summoned to the Academic’s location and combines into creating a Mecha Explosive. [Awakened Passive] Tower Mastery: Academics can now summon up to 3 Engineer towers and 1 Gear Master tower.
 
[Awakened Passive] Gravity Grenade: After pulling enemies to the center of the first explosion of Gravity Grenade, a second explosion occurs. Mecha Duck and Tower aggro will increase for enemies that have been hit.
 
[Awakened Passive] Mechanic Mode: Action Speed increases and Mechanic skills such as Mechanic Gatling, Mechanic Cannon, Mechanic Ice Pump and Mechanic Chain Saw are enhanced.
 
[Awakened Passive] Mecha Duck: The maximum number of Mecha Ducks that can be summoned are increased. Additionally, the Mecha Ducks summoned have enhanced skills.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cf450d192371925d210606fad43504089daae261.png[/img] Shooting Star
Alfredo Drill: Orders Alfredo to charge in with a drill.
 
Summon Buster: Throws a marker at a target location. Alfredo is summoned next to the user and is equipped with artillery to shoot enemies near the marker.
 
[Awakened Passive] Alfredo: Alfredo summoned is bigger in size.
 
[Awakened Passive] Air Shot: Air Shot's Attack Power increases and additional attacks shoot mini bombs.
 
[Awakened Passive] Cannon Blaster: Cannon Blaster's cooldown is reduced and creates 2 explosions.
 
[Awakened Passive] Biochemical Experiment: Poisons enemies when Biochemical Experiment hits them. Poisoned enemies take more Damage.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b89c616742dbf7c1c38528f4c9e9b76409d87c0e.png[/img] Adept
Magma Jump: Jumps forward using the explosive power of magma. You can use the Direction Keys to change its direction while using this skill.
 
Elemental Flair: Creates an [Alchemy Circle] on the floor that combines Fire and Water attributes to pull enemies and induce a powerful explosion. While casting, it constantly pulls and deals damage on enemies and can cause an explosion with the [Normal Attack]. The Attack Power and Area of explosions are increased based on the casting time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Elemental Mastery: Fire and Water attribute attacks combine into an attribute that has higher Attack Power.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Palm: Summons two Ice Palms that guard the user.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Beam: Ice Beam's attack area is increased and shoots faster.
 
[Awakened Passive] Magma Wave: Damage dealt over time after Magma Wave explosions are now deal as a continuous chain of explosions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e84131d222fccbf613f2b70775f85794f860800b.png[/img] Physician
Poison Strike: Attacks enemies with a Syringe. Syringe will break when the attack is successful and a Mini Slime Pool will be formed. The Mini Slime Pool constantly generates Poison Slime that explodes when it comes into contact with enemies.
 
Slime Pool: Summons a Slime Pool under the Academic’s feet. If there already is a Mini Slime Pool nearby, it will also turn into a Slime Pool.
 
[Awakened Passive] Disease: Number of Poison Flasks thrown are reduced to 1 but a Poison Pool will be formed when it breaks to deal damage over time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Poison Break: Additional attacks cause nearby Poison Pools to explode.
 
[Awakened Passive] Injector: When Injector is used, action speed increases and Summon Slime's cooldown is reduced when it hits enemies. Action speed increase is also applicable when it hit allies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Sacrifice: Deals damage to nearby enemies when sacrificed Slime explodes and gives Attack Power buff to allies. The buff increases recovery rate but duration is reduced.



2) Professor K Nest Remedial Class (Hardcore)
  
Professor K's Remedial Classes getting too easy?
 
He has now prepared a tougher curriculum! Are you ready for it?
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cd9cf990e33785432ea74453d17771601aad3669.jpg[/img]

Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3337dc244eba60582e3a762f73732a9056d48896.jpg[/img]
Location: Garden of Eternity > Flickering Spiral Passageway

Rewards
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fda31a714b022c2baca99c5255f8dffb9933ba50.jpg[/img]



3) 7 Practice Nests
 
7 Practice Modes has been added. 
 
Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/86b0e40905572d2ae8d38cc35a1b071d335d4f5f.jpg[/img]

Below is a list of Practice Modes added to Garden of Eternity
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8ebe3b3077ca67f8f926fc7fea2a7388815b9c43.jpg[/img]

Rewards
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/21535e83745323e453bf98fe622e0071f11f8f4f.jpg[/img]



4) X'mas Event
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8fffd8eb7b5337b98b8ca2f8db9e79db9bcb176b.jpg[/img]
Christmas is around the corner! Decorations has been put up in all of Altera to celebrate this festive season!
 
 
Santa Orc's Getaway Dungeon
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0c2de90a9a04ea8fd619aef5afc4368e48e1e788.png[/img]

Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f6dae038db2db4b0346441816487ba4084056ef6.jpg[/img]

You can enter Santa Orc's Getaway via Daredevil Faire.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/63fee8866fcba285041eed50098808000067d98d.png[/img]
Simply make Santa Orc fall by using skills or bombs that have been placed around the map. As he falls, there's a chance he may drop Santa Orc's Gift Pouch and other random debuff items.

Rewards
 
You can get one of the following items from [Santa Orc’s Gift Pouch]. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01d95cbcda0dac931d2cfdbccead64c5e0389e2a.jpg[/img]

Christmas Store
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d417f99e89eb2d4a06d0030a98b81598bada2504.png[/img]

You can spend the 2016 Christmas Exchange Coupon at NPC Cassie to buy the following items:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/08b3cd003cdc62155b49fd67960bf8d4719d4e42.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/13be43336637149802b42772677a24f078a41639.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2e6eced9d03ec65d758b0f4f1921bd0036da50ae.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04153abe2cf26f6dccd9e56d8c07bfd44068a3b0.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0b53b781b5a62a68e8d30d5cf8eed68e1238d2e1.png[/img]



5) Dragon Hunting Day
 
Hunt down Dragons every day, without worries of resurrection counts!
 
Simple click on the Dragon Hunting Icon at the bottom right of the screen during the designated hours (schedule below), and you will automatically be matched up with other Heroes.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/161d50aea10b0e8a1866bbb52d72f49c92044c3c.png[/img]
Notes:
- You cannot enter in a party.
- Dragon Hunting Day is played in "Compensation On" mode, which means your equipment does not matter in Dragon Hunting Day. All your stats are balanced (similar to Equalize in PVP).
- No reduction in durability
 
Schedule
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d54b7a1140c869d21d9d295d062667e0ec4c5603.png[/img]
*Above Timings are in PST



6) Others
 
A) Store Changes
 
Weapon Engraving Pouch has been added to the Goddess Aura Store.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c2dcbc3a2c6104e23a4e73ebdf17d9b8fa5b17fb.png[/img]
*It can be bought with 60 Goddess's Aura (2 per week), or with 40x Scroll Fragments and 5 gold (no limit)
 
 
Holy Shield skill heraldry has been removed. As such, it will no longer drop or sold at the Goddess's Sparkle Store.
 
 
B) Achievement Window
 
[Practice Mode] category has been added to the Nest tab of the achievement window.
You can find related achievements for existing and new practice mode nests there.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/961d3c7a40561d90175625c1c492df55990a85ec.png[/img]

C) Misc
 
Crafting Improvements
 
Skill Accessories equipped with Dragon Gem cannot be used as crafting materials anymore.
 
Changes in Equipment Repair Cost
 
Fixing cost for equipment will be reduced by 30% compared to the past. (All Rare grade Weapon/Armor, Epic grade Weapon/Armor below Lv80)

Changes in Hero’s Battlefield Rewards
 
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard): Special Skill Dragon Gem is removed, Goddess’s Lament x1, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x1 are added
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard Core): Goddess’s Lament x2, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x2 are added

Rock of Blessing
 
Rock of Blessing cannot be destroyed now.
Drop rate for Rock of Blessing is lowered. (Maximum quantity for each server remains the same)

Changes in Ice Dragon Stage 2 Skill
 
When Ice Dragon Stage 2 boss “Killing Machine Balapa” uses “Absorption” attack, all status effects on Balapa will be removed. (Applicable in all difficulty levels)

Changes in World Zone Resurrection Method
 
If you become a ghost in the World Zone, you can resurrect without using the Resurrection Scroll.
 
 
D) Balancing
[Work in Progress]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b89c616742dbf7c1c38528f4c9e9b76409d87c0e.png[/img] Adept
Magma Jump: Jumps forward using the explosive power of magma. You can use the Direction Keys to change its direction while using this skill.
 
Elemental Flair: Creates an [Alchemy Circle] on the floor that combines Fire and Water attributes to pull enemies and induce a powerful explosion. While casting, it constantly pulls and deals damage on enemies and can cause an explosion with the [Normal Attack]. The Attack Power and Area of explosions are increased based on the casting time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Elemental Mastery: Fire and Water attribute attacks combine into an attribute that has higher Attack Power.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Palm: Summons two Ice Palms that guard the user.
 
[Awakened Passive] Ice Beam: Ice Beam's attack area is increased and shoots faster.
 
[Awakened Passive] Magma Wave: Damage dealt over time after Magma Wave explosions are now deal as a continuous chain of explosions.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e84131d222fccbf613f2b70775f85794f860800b.png[/img] Physician
Poison Strike: Attacks enemies with a Syringe. Syringe will break when the attack is successful and a Mini Slime Pool will be formed. The Mini Slime Pool constantly generates Poison Slime that explodes when it comes into contact with enemies.
 
Slime Pool: Summons a Slime Pool under the Academic’s feet. If there already is a Mini Slime Pool nearby, it will also turn into a Slime Pool.
 
[Awakened Passive] Disease: Number of Poison Flasks thrown are reduced to 1 but a Poison Pool will be formed when it breaks to deal damage over time.
 
[Awakened Passive] Poison Break: Additional attacks cause nearby Poison Pools to explode.
 
[Awakened Passive] Injector: When Injector is used, action speed increases and Summon Slime's cooldown is reduced when it hits enemies. Action speed increase is also applicable when it hit allies.
 
[Awakened Passive] Sacrifice: Deals damage to nearby enemies when sacrificed Slime explodes and gives Attack Power buff to allies. The buff increases recovery rate but duration is reduced.



2) Professor K Nest Remedial Class (Hardcore)
  
Professor K's Remedial Classes getting too easy?
 
He has now prepared a tougher curriculum! Are you ready for it?
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/cd9cf990e33785432ea74453d17771601aad3669.jpg[/img]

Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3337dc244eba60582e3a762f73732a9056d48896.jpg[/img]
Location: Garden of Eternity > Flickering Spiral Passageway

Rewards
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/fda31a714b022c2baca99c5255f8dffb9933ba50.jpg[/img]

Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/86b0e40905572d2ae8d38cc35a1b071d335d4f5f.jpg[/img]

Below is a list of Practice Modes added to Garden of Eternity
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8ebe3b3077ca67f8f926fc7fea2a7388815b9c43.jpg[/img]

Rewards
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/21535e83745323e453bf98fe622e0071f11f8f4f.jpg[/img]



4) X'mas Event
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/8fffd8eb7b5337b98b8ca2f8db9e79db9bcb176b.jpg[/img]
Christmas is around the corner! Decorations has been put up in all of Altera to celebrate this festive season!
 
 
Santa Orc's Getaway Dungeon
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0c2de90a9a04ea8fd619aef5afc4368e48e1e788.png[/img]

Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/f6dae038db2db4b0346441816487ba4084056ef6.jpg[/img]

You can enter Santa Orc's Getaway via Daredevil Faire.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/63fee8866fcba285041eed50098808000067d98d.png[/img]
Simply make Santa Orc fall by using skills or bombs that have been placed around the map. As he falls, there's a chance he may drop Santa Orc's Gift Pouch and other random debuff items.

Rewards
 
You can get one of the following items from [Santa Orc’s Gift Pouch]. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/01d95cbcda0dac931d2cfdbccead64c5e0389e2a.jpg[/img]

Christmas Store
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d417f99e89eb2d4a06d0030a98b81598bada2504.png[/img]

You can spend the 2016 Christmas Exchange Coupon at NPC Cassie to buy the following items:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/08b3cd003cdc62155b49fd67960bf8d4719d4e42.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/13be43336637149802b42772677a24f078a41639.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2e6eced9d03ec65d758b0f4f1921bd0036da50ae.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04153abe2cf26f6dccd9e56d8c07bfd44068a3b0.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/0b53b781b5a62a68e8d30d5cf8eed68e1238d2e1.png[/img]



5) Dragon Hunting Day
 
Hunt down Dragons every day, without worries of resurrection counts!
 
Simple click on the Dragon Hunting Icon at the bottom right of the screen during the designated hours (schedule below), and you will automatically be matched up with other Heroes.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/161d50aea10b0e8a1866bbb52d72f49c92044c3c.png[/img]
Notes:
- You cannot enter in a party.
- Dragon Hunting Day is played in "Compensation On" mode, which means your equipment does not matter in Dragon Hunting Day. All your stats are balanced (similar to Equalize in PVP).
- No reduction in durability
 
Schedule
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d54b7a1140c869d21d9d295d062667e0ec4c5603.png[/img]
*Above Timings are in PST



6) Others
 
A) Store Changes
 
Weapon Engraving Pouch has been added to the Goddess Aura Store.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c2dcbc3a2c6104e23a4e73ebdf17d9b8fa5b17fb.png[/img]
*It can be bought with 60 Goddess's Aura (2 per week), or with 40x Scroll Fragments and 5 gold (no limit)
 
 
Holy Shield skill heraldry has been removed. As such, it will no longer drop or sold at the Goddess's Sparkle Store.
 
 
B) Achievement Window
 
[Practice Mode] category has been added to the Nest tab of the achievement window.
You can find related achievements for existing and new practice mode nests there.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/961d3c7a40561d90175625c1c492df55990a85ec.png[/img]

C) Misc
 
Crafting Improvements
 
Skill Accessories equipped with Dragon Gem cannot be used as crafting materials anymore.
 
Changes in Equipment Repair Cost
 
Fixing cost for equipment will be reduced by 30% compared to the past. (All Rare grade Weapon/Armor, Epic grade Weapon/Armor below Lv80)

Changes in Hero’s Battlefield Rewards
 
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard): Special Skill Dragon Gem is removed, Goddess’s Lament x1, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x1 are added
Hero’s Battlefield (Hard Core): Goddess’s Lament x2, Rare Grade Gold Pouch x2 are added

Rock of Blessing
 
Rock of Blessing cannot be destroyed now.
Drop rate for Rock of Blessing is lowered. (Maximum quantity for each server remains the same)

Changes in Ice Dragon Stage 2 Skill
 
When Ice Dragon Stage 2 boss “Killing Machine Balapa” uses “Absorption” attack, all status effects on Balapa will be removed. (Applicable in all difficulty levels)

Changes in World Zone Resurrection Method
 
If you become a ghost in the World Zone, you can resurrect without using the Resurrection Scroll.
 
 
D) Balancing
[Work in Progress]

notes.title: [Write Up Event] To my side, Buddy!
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
What do you do, when the whole world seems to be against you?
 
Who stands with you through thick and thin, against darker times?
 
As we go through countless ups and downs in our Dragon Nest journey, we all remember that ONE special person who made our stay in Dragon Nest worth it - That buddy/friend/guildmate/lover who stands by us against all odds.
 
Share with us the stories of you and that special person! Tell us everything about the both of you, and stand to win a prize (For BOTH of you of course!).
 
 
Event Period: 15th December ~ 20th December 2359HRS (PST) / 21st December 0259HRS (EST)
 
Instructions:
 
1) Choose ONE person whom you deem the most special/closest to you in Dragon Nest. Kindly state both IGNs clearly in the write-up.
 
2) Write a short story of 200-300 words, describing how the both of you met, memorable stuff done together (or anything interesting and significant between two of you)
 
3) Include an image with both you and your buddy in it. Take an in-game screenshot and edit it (if you want). Hell, draw the picture yourself if you’re up for it! It’s all up to your creativity!
 
4) Send the story to this email: dnevents@eyedentitygames.com
 
 
We have included a sample write up here as a reference.
 
 
We will select the best 5 entries, and reward these 5 pairs with a permanent X’mas costume package in the upcoming update! The top 5 entries will also have their stories published on the forums.
 
Do not fret! We will give out consolation prizes to non-winners for the effort too, so we highly encourage everyone to participate.
 
 
Important notes:
 
- Only 2 characters per submission (you and your buddy)
- The cut-off date for submissions is 20th December 2359HRS (PST) / 21st December 0259HRS (EST)
- Rewards will be credited on 22nd December during the maintenance.

Professor K Nest (Normal)
Ice Dragon Nest (Normal)

notes.title: The Numbers Game – Red Waste
notes.content:
Dear Heroes,
 
This Saturday, on the 3rd December, there will be a dungeon clearing event.
 
THIS TIME HOWEVER… There’ll be a twist. We’ll be playing a numbers game using clear counts from the Red Waste dungeon.
 
 
Mechanics
 
Date/Time: 3rd December (Saturday), 1800HRS – 2059HRS (PST) / 2100HRS - 2359HRS (EST)
 
Map: Red Waste (Any Difficulty)
 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/926814eda0e3237f8f308875b6e138118ee1e8d6.png[/img]
 
How it works:
 
Clearing Red Waste in any difficulty earns your character One clear count.
 
During the event period, every player who clears this dungeon will have their clear counts tracked.
 
The winners will be determined by those whom have the Lowest Unique Clear Counts by the end of the event. Think of it as a Lottery, but using dungeon clear counts.
 
Here’s an example:
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5fdb4fb65729121cab1bec4c50ad671064c6b2b2.jpg[/img]
 
- Player E gets the 1st Place, because he is the only player with 13 clear counts (no other players have this number), and also the lowest clear count (as compared to player G and J).
 
- Player A and B both have 10 clear counts, therefore their clear count is no longer Unique. The same happens with player C, D and F, and player H and I. These players will be eliminated, but a small consolation gift will be rewarded.
 
 
Remember, the above just an example. Your clear counts will be compared across the board with all players who clears this dungeon (during the stated event period).
 
*Tip: Even though the higher clear counts you have would mean a better chance of having a unique number, it’s also about running just enough to make your clear count unique. It’s not entirely about luck, but also with careful estimation!
 
 
Rewards
 
1st Place: Mount + 200 Jellies
 
2nd Place: Mount + 100 Jellies
 
3rd Place: Mount + 50 Jellies
 
Winners may select 1 of the 5 choices of mounts below:
 
Angel Sheep
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/55e567c3ee4c4cec2e881404d641ab5506b6894a.png[/img]
 
Original Gryphios
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/d4dff0886d9e8bec42599429e88c60f7c611cc5c.png[/img]
 
Topaz Wind Dragon
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4b03beadef0c00b359a121f58a29209bf24ad4f0.png[/img]
 
Soft White Cloud Mount
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/55e567c3ee4c4cec2e881404d641ab5506b6894a.png[/img]
 
SS Ideal mk-0
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/20718784735fa4e6dc24fbf79ae1d880f58550bb.png[/img]

Important Notes:
- Rewards are character base, but there can only be 1 winning character per account.
- Rewards will be credited during the maintenance on 8th December
- It is every player’s own responsibility to keep track of their own clear counts.
- One clear count = Clearing the stage from start to end (select treasure box and exit map). Prematurely exiting the dungeon does not qualify as one clear count.

notes.title: Professor K Patch Notes 24th November
notes.content:
1. Professor K Nest Remedial Class (Normal)
Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/04e189ab6642f57cc3f75a4460387ee8fce88b03.png[/img] 

 
Rewards
 
You can get the followintg rewards upon completion of the nest:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/e748be72d2cfe4659e92f968760c2ab6ccef3e4f.png[/img]
 
- Desirous / Ultimate Theano Equipments
- Armour Engraving Scroll
- Enhancement Crest Plate
- Epic Dragon Gems
- Hardened Drakonite
 
 
2. Ice Dragon Nest Practice Mode
 
Entry Info
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ffec07b28053abbf648136b526089b6222db04cb.png[/img] 

 
- Monsters in Practice Mode have 75% of attack power and HP of those in Normal Mode.
- With the addition of Practice Mode, the number of resurrections allowed in Ice Dragon Nest (Normal, 8-player nest) and Red Dragon Nest (Normal, 8-player nest) has been increased to 3 times.
 
Rewards
 
You can get the following Title from Ice Dragon Nest (Practice Mode)
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a5d20921860f270aa6b563a6db36ac390c2212cf.png[/img]

 
 
3. Reboot Daredevil Faire
 
Entry Info
 
Additional dungeons has been added to Daredevil Faire.
 
Reckless Umrak
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/95d2cfc5d7fde9476b83b01dd53f660f84cbccbf.png[/img]
 

 
Thorny Path
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/317c5bf05f64214e81d8299171a26c3e3f50668e.png[/img]

 
Hot-tempered Bacchus
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1fb751aaf5db48381ac3288e1e6381a6f024a5e7.png[/img]

 
To enter these dungeons, you need to speak to Magician Sanders and pick up a daily quest. Upon finishing the quest, you will be given some Entry Tickets.
Only characters level 70 and above can get Daily Quests from Magician Sanders.
 
 
 
4. Loffy's Dicey Dungeon
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/97c5376928781b278f0b75f927dababd46fa0010.png[/img]

 
Loffy's Dicey Dungeon is back and updated with Level 93 Rewards!
 
Entry Info
 
- Click on the Dice Icon to access the dungeon.
- You may enter the second time if you receive tickets from other players.
- Please note that Loffy's Dicey Dungeon will be closed every Saturday from 0730HRS to 0930HRS (PST)
 
Rewards
 
Below is a list of possible rewards from Loffy's Dicey Dungeon:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/236ad02e79844ff884ed4d447daf09d4968d3d93.jpg[/img]
 

 
 
 
 5. Ladder 1:1 Rank Battle ( Unavailable for now )
Due to a system issue, ladder will not be available and is expected to be fixed on 1st December's maintenance.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b3366d4d5614b736b926be6989d0ee10d8c376bd.jpg[/img]
 
1:1 Rank Battle is an improved version of the previous Ladder, and rewards in the ladder shop has also been updated.
 
Will YOU be the one to hold the Diamond Tier rank?
 
Entry Info
 
You can participate in 1:1 Rank Battle the same way as Ladder.
 
Method 1: Matching UI
 
Click on the Matching Icon to open up the Matching UI
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b6d736bbbf9f3b8c26edc0ed1fda917e6b32d69d.jpg[/img]
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/a9e959adef620bcda9c192a3ef67f7197315a7e1.png[/img]
 


 
Method 2: Colosseum UI
 
You may also enter via the colosseum window, then click on the 1:1 Rank tab.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/5b7ba368c1faf457c774067a8ecace2884ba499c.png[/img]

 
Mechanics
 
- When you enter the 1:1 Rank map, you will see the Tier next to the character name as shown below.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/978e31f54cf4ccbc5a98817edfe43cf313d7b609.png[/img]

 
- Battle will be held for 5 minutes, during which you have to try to kill your opponent.
- Should both combatants remain standing after 5 minutes, the winner will be decided by the one with the higher remaining HP ratio.
- Winner will score points, EXP, and ladder points. Loser will get their ratings deducted and will not earn any ladder points
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4debb54a0d74252a6fc4f96aab2b22c006670077.jpg[/img]
 
- During the battle, you are not allowed to change equipment.
- If you leave the battle while it is still ongoing, you will be barred from entering another ladder match for 15 minutes.
 
 
Ranks
 
There are 16 rank tiers in total (including Unranked)
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/4285bc43210c0d371a51de5d4049c1564f9b5334.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/b866f30021f0e20af30dfb7f13dffe9580a16a22.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1e459243f54664e51d97c48b73d967b518c56431.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/2c86e64fff2bf7a2540ec8927874b0363cce60ff.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/99021c1ab523335823fc47eaca8e0967ecf8aadc.jpg[/img]



 
- The Tier you have achieved will be maintained in the current regular season and pre-season.
- When the ranking is refreshed every morning while the season is ongoing, your Tier can rise or drop.
 
You may also choose to show your ranking via the options menu:
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/1ab18a7028941e9d2e30bc8871cf5965c928d187.jpg[/img]

 
- The Tier you have achieved can be shown by selecting it in the Game Options.
- You can either show your Colosseum rank or Rank Tier.
- Not only you, but all characters will see the Rank Tier if you set it to be visible.
 
 
Ladder Points
 
When you win Ladder matches, you gain ladder points. However, there is a daily limit to the amount of points you can earn.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/bbca63e3ec67667ee73fe0cefe4384d5fa23311d.jpg[/img]

 
 
Score Penalty
 
 
- Score penalty will occur when you don’t play 1:1 Rank Battle for a long time. (To prevent players from not playing after achieving a high score)
- If there are no records of playing within the penalty period, your score will be deducted according to the penalty value.
- Play record will be checked every morning and corresponding amount of penalty will be deducted.

A. Engraving System
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/64798dd83066a1b0fdabb0ff60a1ef695a6cfa84.jpg[/img]

 
The Engraving System allows you to use Engraving Scrolls to enhance the stats of cash equipments.
 
[Armour Engraving Scroll] can be used on [Helmet] [Top] [Bottom] [Gloves] [Shoes] cash items which are Rare Grade or higher.
[Overall Engraving Scroll] can be used on [Overall] cash items which are Rare Grade or higher.
 
*Engraving scrolls for Weapons and Accessories will be released in the future
 
Items that has Engraving will be indicated by a "+" icon:
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/03b357bd48b99dff9f602d3555bab5fa27934d10.jpg[/img]

 
Important note
 
- Only 1 Engraving is allowed for each item. New Engravings will overwrite the previous engraving effect.
- When items with Engraving are traded, the Engraving effect will follow as well.
- Engraving can be done on durational items as well. (However, Engraving effect will disappear when the item expires.)
 
 
B. +10 level 93 Dragon Gem
 
Level 93 Dragon Gems can now be enhanced to +10.
 
Enhancement attempts level of +8 ~ +10 will require Hardened Drakonite (Obtainable from Professor K Nest)
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/96dd8ee25685d5d466d8c6144ceeffd5b60d9d20.jpg[/img]

 
 
C. Dragon Gem Disassembly
 
The amount of Dragon Gem fragments dropped by Disassembling Dragon Gems will now scale with the enhancement level of the disassembled Dragon Gem.
 
When a +15 Dragon Gem is disassembled, you can get a Fusion Cube.

The Type and Enhancement level of Dragon Gems slotted in equipments are now reflected in the tooltip.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/125e83539c7c3716840f38b9fd59bceeb5bb47c7.jpg[/img]

 
 
E. Goddess's Aura Store
 
Engraving Scroll Pouch has been added to the Goddess's Aura Store.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/3fdbf6ae5b368c4ec565040b261be78e97140c65.jpg[/img]

 
*Scroll Fragments can be obtained by disassembling Engraving Scrolls.
 
 
F. Ice Dragon Reward Changes
 
8-player Ice Dragon Nest (normal)'s rewards have been enhanced.
 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/c84afe3807394bf5be95f8e6cbea780ed17d70bd.jpg[/img]

Ladder:
 
All classes’ equipment stats ratio will be changed.
 
- Attack power ratio will be reduced.
- Defence power ratio will be increased.
- Max HP ratio will be increased.
 
 
Warden:
 
Cannonade (PVE, PVP)
- Hit area is shown immediately when the skill begins and hit area can be changed by changing the mouse direction (up or down).

Cyclone Harpoon (PVE, PVP)

- Can now be stored in the server storage.

notes.title: 2016 October Event line-up
notes.content:
Hello Heroes! 

Here're our October - Halloween- event lists !



1. Wake up your Chronicle characters!

From 27th October to 23rd November, complete certain tasks with a Chronicles character, and you will be rewarded with various goodies!
 
 
Task 1: Attain Level 93 with a Chronicle Character
 
Reward: Four National Flags (USA, Australia, Canada, New Zealand)
 
Task 2: Complete BOTH Archbishop Nest and Manticore Nest (Normal) with a Chronicle Character
 
Reward: Halloween Dragon Egg x 2
 
Task 3: Complete BOTH Archbishop Nest and Manticore Nest (Hardcore) with a Chronicle Character
 
Reward: Halloween Dragon Egg x 2
 
 
Important Notes:
 
- Rewards will be credited weekly during the weekly maintenance
- Rewards are crediting on a per-account basis
- Each account can only get each task's reward once






2. Ghost Gesture at your first login day! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4328878/ff611e8d221e2895847dd33e330a73c1a2327911.png[/img]

And at 2nd day, you will receive our new Halloween Double Dragon egg!






3. Halloween Screenshot Party! 

Winning DNP from taking screenshots with fellow heroes sounds too good to be true? Is this a Trick.....
...or a Treat?
 
It's a TREAT! 
 
From 30th October to 5th November (PST), take your best in-game screenshot with your friends and stand a chance to win DNP!
 
Here's how it works:
 
1) Take an in-game screenshot with your friends, choose one that best expresses the Halloween atmosphere. Maximum of 10 characters can be in a single screenshot.

2) Post the Screenshot in the Eyedentity official Forums "http://forum.dragonnest.com/forum/community/fan-creations" 

3) Character names must be clearly displayed in the screenshot. The character names should also be written in the forum post itself.

4) Top 3 winners will be determined by the number of Likes on the forum post
 
 
There will be two groups of winners for this event.
 
Group 1: Top 3 Screenshots selected by the community
1st: 20000 DNP for every character in the screenshot
2nd: 10000 DNP for every character in the screenshot
3rd: 5000 DNP for every character in the screenshot
 
Group 2: Eyedentity's selection
Eyedentity will select their favourite submission, and reward 20000 DNP to every character in the screenshot.
 
Important note:
 
- Each account is entitled to only 1 tier of the rewards, even if the characters appear in multiple winning entries. For eg, Player A appears in the 1st place screenshot, but also appears in the 2nd place screenshot (with the same character or a different character in the same account), he will only receive the reward for 1st place (20000 DNP).

notes.title: Complete Patch Notes – The Nightmare Grows
notes.content:
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6564b8d6-31b1-4ff7-8594-373ee4a792cc.jpg[/img]

Read all about the latest update arriving on [B]May 12[/B]. Venture deep into the Nightmare Nest and make your way to the 4th Floor to meet its new bosses! The Dragon Vault will also be updated with new goodies.

[B]New Content [/B]
- Updated Nightmare Nest 
- Dragon Vault Update

[B]Additional Updates [/B]
- Bug Fixes

[b]Updated Nightmare Nest[/b]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-6aa0d982-0010-428f-b264-c0835762d2ba.jpg[/img]

The might of the Monolith has succeeded in adding an additional floor to the Nightmare Nest! Grab your friends and journey deep inside until you find the new 4th Floor. Several bosses wait for you there, including the final boss, the Nightmare Watchman, who performs spin and rush attacks and throws a powerful fireball!

To enter the nightmare, [url=http://dragonnest.nexon.net/news/news/00Iur][B]click here[/B][/url].

[b]Dragon Vault Update[/b]
[img]http://nxcache.nexon.net/spotlight/243/00ITZ-8a9bef8a-9ae9-4705-b8ab-5bfda6013ea3.jpg[/img]

Royalty has come to the Dragon Vault! The Royal Viking lords and ladies are dressed to the nines, and you can look fashionable too with these new rare-grade costume sets. Pick up a package and also receive a Force Converter!

The Royal Vikings have brought their style to the Dragon Eggs as well! Dragon Eggs have been updated with a romantic wedding mount, a weapon coupon, and a Pure Royal Viking wing, tail, and decal set.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Various texts have been updated. 
- The Skill-Up Crest Pouch item now functions correctly. 
- The Tinkerer’s skill ‘Class Mastery II’ now functions as intended. 
- Little Winnie's Argenta costume now displays correctly.
